eng:
1. 	God Is Love 	Sun, Jun 28
a. 	What evidence of God’s love is given to humanity? Exodus 34:6, 7; Jonah 4:2 (last part); Jeremiah 31:3.
“The word of God reveals His character. He Himself has declared His infinite love and pity. When Moses prayed, ‘Show me Thy glory,’ the Lord answered, ‘I will make all My goodness pass before thee.’ Exodus 33:18, 19. This is His glory. The Lord passed before Moses, and proclaimed, ‘The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, long-suffering, and abundant in goodness and truth, keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin.’ Exodus 34:6, 7. He is ‘slow to anger, and of great kindness,’ ‘because He delighteth in mercy.’ Jonah 4:2; Micah 7:18.”—Steps to Christ, p. 10.
b. 	What was God’s purpose in sending His Son? Matthew 11:27; John 14:8, 9.
“Satan led men to conceive of God as a being whose chief attribute is stern justice—one who is a severe judge, a harsh, exacting creditor. He pictured the Creator as a being who is watching with jealous eye to discern the errors and mistakes of men, that He may visit judgments upon them. It was to remove this dark shadow, by revealing to the world the infinite love of God, that Jesus came to live among men.”—Ibid., p. 11.
bem:
1. 	LESA KUTEMWA                                                                            Cimo, June 28
a. 	Cishininkisho nshi ica kutemwa ukwa kwa Lesa ukwapelwa ku mutundu wa muntu nse? Ukufuma 34:6, 7; Yona 4:2 (icipande cakulekelesha); Yeremia 31:3.
“Ishiwi lyakwa Lesa lisokolola umubele wakwe. Ena pa lwakwe aliba uwa kulangisha ukutemwa pamofye no kusakamana. Lintu Mose akwete ukupepa ukuti, nangisheni ubukata bwenu, shikulu alyaswike no kutila kuli wena; ndi no kulenga ubusuma bwandi bonse ukupita ku menso yobe. Ukufuma 33:18,19. Ubu e bukata bwakwe. Shikulu alikwete ukupita ku mulola wakwa Mose; no kubilikisha ati, ‘shikulu, shikulu Lesa’, uwaluse kabili uwa cikuku, uukokola ukukalipa kabili uwafulisha ubusuma pamo fye ne cishinka, uu sungilila uluse ku bamakana, uwelela amampulu, bumpula mafunde elyo no lubembu. Ukufuma 34:6,7.  Alakokola ukufulwa kabili aba no kusakamana ukwafulisha, pa mulandu wa kuti akwata ukusekelela mu luse. Yona 4:2; Mika 7:18.”—Steps to
b. Bwali bufwayo nshi ubwa kwa Lesa mukuba uwakutuma umwana wakwe? Mateo 11:27; Yohane14:8, 9.
“Shetani alilenga abantu ukusumina ukuti Lesa aba ni uyo uwa ishibikilwa ku kwafya, nga umo uwaba ni kapingula uwa shupisha, uwayafya kabili kapatikisha. Alaba (shetani) uwa kumona kabumba ngo muntu uu kwatafye ukupenenga (ukufwailisha) ne linso lyakwe ilya kalumwa, mukulolesha pa filubo pamo ne mipuso ya bantu, pa kutila fye engaba uwakuleta ubupingushi pali bena. Kwali kufumyapo kwa ici icinshingwa icafita, ukupitila mukusokolola ku calo ukutemwa ukwabula impela ukwa kwa Lesa, e kwalengele Yesu ukuti akwate ukwisa no kuba uwa kwikala pakati ka bantu”—Ibid., p.11.

eng:
2. 	The Mission of Jesus 	Mon, Jun 29
a. 	How did Jesus describe His earthly mission? Luke 4:16–18.
“[Luke 4:18 quoted.] This was [Jesus’] work. He went about doing good and healing all that were oppressed by Satan. There were whole villages where there was not a moan of sickness in any house, for He had passed through them and healed all their sick. His work gave evidence of His divine anointing. Love, mercy, and compassion were revealed in every act of His life; His heart went out in tender sympathy to the children of men. He took man’s nature, that He might reach man’s wants. The poorest and humblest were not afraid to approach Him. Even little children were attracted to Him. They loved to climb upon His knees and gaze into the pensive face, benignant with love.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 11, 12.
“Jesus saw in every soul one to whom must be given the call to His kingdom. He reached the hearts of the people by going among them as one who desired their good. He sought them in the public streets, in private houses, on the boats, in the synagogue, by the shores of the lake, and at the marriage feast. He met them at their daily vocations, and manifested an interest in their secular affairs. He carried His instruction into the household, bringing families in their own homes under the influence of His divine presence. His strong personal sympathy helped to win hearts. He often repaired to the mountains for solitary prayer, but this was a preparation for His labor among men in active life. From these seasons He came forth to relieve the sick, to instruct the ignorant, and to break the chains from the captives of Satan.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 151.
b. 	Although full of love and compassion, what is an example of Christ’s faithfulness in rebuking wrong? John 9:39–41; Matthew 21:12, 13.
“Jesus did not suppress one word of truth, but He uttered it always in love. He exercised the greatest tact and thoughtful, kind attention in His intercourse with the people. He was never rude, never needlessly spoke a severe word, never gave needless pain to a sensitive soul. He did not censure human weakness. He spoke the truth, but always in love. He denounced hypocrisy, unbelief, and iniquity; but tears were in His voice as He uttered His scathing rebukes. . . . Every soul was precious in His eyes. While He ever bore Himself with divine dignity, He bowed with the tenderest regard to every member of the family of God. In all men He saw fallen souls whom it was His mission to save.”—Steps to Christ, p. 12.
bem:
2.  UMULIMO WAKWA YESU                                                                            Pali cibili, Jun 29
a. 	Ni shani Yesu ali uwa kulondolola umulimo wakwe uwa pe sonde? Luka 4:16–18.
"[Luka 4:18 ngeipelwe.] Uyu wali e mulimo wakwa Yesu, aile alecita icisuma pamofye no kuposha bonse fye abatitikishiwe na shetani. Takwaliko umushi nangu umo uwa kwete ukusangwamo ukuteta kwa malwele mu mayanda yonse. Neci cali mulandu wakuti alikwete ukupita muli cilang`anda no kuba uwa kuposha bonse abalwele babo. No mulimo wakwe walikwete ukupela icishininkisho icakusubwa kwakwe ukwa buLesa. Ukutemwa, uluse pamofye no kusakamana fyalikwete ukusokololwa muli cila cicitwa conse ica mweo wakwe; umutima wakwe walekwata inkuntu mutima iya kusakamana kubana ba bantu. Abulile icipasho ca buntu pa kutila fye engaba uwa kufikilisha amabukabilo ya muntu. Abaculisha pamofye na bali no mushinku uwa panshi saana tabalekwata ukutina ukumukumanya. Na bana abanono bali abakongolwa kuli wena. Balitemenwe ukunina pa makufi yakwe no kulakwata ukwinwina ifinso fyabo pa cinso cakwe icalebengeshima no kutemwa ukwacila.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 11, 12.
“Yesu amwene ukuti  cila mupashi wali  uwalinga ku kupelwa ubwite ubwa ku bufumu bwakwe. Alikwete ukufika ku mitima ya bantu, pakuba uwa kuya pakati kabo nga umo uwalekabila ubusuma bwabo. Alebasokota bena mu misebo, mu mayanda ayafiswa, mu mato, muma sunagogi, pa lulamba lwa mimana kabili na pa mitebeto ya fyupo. Abakumenye mumakwebo yabo aya cilabushiku no kuba uwa kulangisha ukufwaisha ukwakusekelela mu tumilimo twabo utwa mikalile. Asendele ikambisho lyakwe mukati kang`anda, ukuba uwakuleta indupwa mu mayanda yabo abene pesamba lya lwambu lwakubapo kwakwe ukwa buLesa. Ukusakamana kwakwe ukwakosa, kwalikwete ukwafwilisha kwa kunonka imitima.  Ilingiline alekwata ukuya ku mpili mukukwata amapepo ayakuba eka, lelo ici cali cakuipekanishisha ku mulimo wakwe pakati kabantu mu mweo wa kupikintika. Ukufuma kuli ishi inshita alikwete ukwisa ku kuposha abalwele, ukukambisha ababulisha ukwiluka, pamofye no kuputaula iminyololo mukukwata ukukakulwa ukufuma mubusha bwakwa shetani.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 151.
b. Nangula aba uwa kwisushiwamo no kutemwa pamo fye no kusakamana, cilangililo nshi ica bucishinka bwakwa Klistu mu kwebaula icilubo?   Yohane 9:39–41; Mateo 21:12, 13.
“Yesu tacefesheko ishiwi nangu limo ilya cine, lelo aleba uwa kulisosa fye lyonse mukutemwa. Alibomfeshe umungalato uukalamba no kusakamana ukwakulanguluka kabili ukwa kutemwa mukwampana kwakwe na bantu. Tatalile abapo uwafulwa nangu fye kulandapo ishiwi ilili lyonse ilyakucena, kabili tatalile abomfyapo ubukali ubwa bucaibela kumupashi uwalekabila. Takwete ukwebaula ubunake bwa mutundu wa muntunse. Asosele icine, lelo lyonsefye calekwata ukusoswa mukutemwa. Alikalipile bu mumbimunda, ukukana sumina, pamofye na mampulu; lelo uluse lwaleba mwishiwi lyakwe ilyo lyonse lintu alekwata ukuba uwa kwebaula…cila mupashi wali uukankala mu menso yakwe. Mukuba uwakufwala fye lyonse ubucindami ubwa buLesa alikwete ukuinasha pa muku umowine no kusakamana ukwa kutemwa kuli cila cilundwa icalupwa lwakwa Lesa. Muli cila muntu fye onse aleba uwa kumonamo imipashi iyawa abo abali e mulimo wakwe uwa kupususha.”—Steps to Christ, p. 12.

eng:
3. 	A Life of Self-Denial 	Tue, Jun 30
a. 	What heavy burden was carried by our Saviour during His life? Isaiah 53:5–7; Luke 2:48, 49.
“Jesus carried the awful weight of responsibility for the salvation of men. He knew that unless there was a decided change in the principles and purposes of the human race, all would be lost. This was the burden of His soul, and none could appreciate the weight that rested upon Him. Through childhood, youth, and manhood, He walked alone. Yet it was heaven to be in His presence. Day by day He met trials and temptations; day by day He was brought into contact with evil, and witnessed its power upon those whom He was seeking to bless and to save. Yet He did not fail nor become discouraged.
“In all things He brought His wishes into strict abeyance to His mission. He glorified His life by making everything in it subordinate to the will of His Father. When in His youth, His mother, finding Him in the school of the rabbis, said, ‘Son, why hast Thou thus dealt with us?’ He answered—and His answer is the keynote of His lifework—‘How is it that ye sought Me? wist ye not that I must be about My Father’s business?’
“His life was one of constant self-sacrifice. He had no home in this world, except as the kindness of friends provided for Him as a wayfarer. He came to live in our behalf the life of the poorest, and to walk and work among the needy and the suffering. Unrecognized and unhonored, He walked in and out among the people for whom He had done so much.”—Gospel Workers, pp. 42, 43.
b. 	What does the outflowing of God’s abundant love teach us concerning our heavenly Father? John 3:16; 1 John 4:9, 10.
“This great sacrifice was not made in order to create in the Father’s heart a love for man, not to make Him willing to save. No, no! ‘God so loved the world, that He gave His only-begotten Son.’ John 3:16. The Father loves us, not because of the great propitiation, but He provided the propitiation because He loves us. Christ was the medium through which He could pour out His infinite love upon a fallen world. ‘God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto Himself.’ 2 Corinthians 5:19. God suffered with His Son. In the agony of Gethsemane, the death of Calvary, the heart of Infinite Love paid the price of our redemption.”—Steps to Christ, p. 13.
bem:
3. UMWEO WAKUIKANYA                                                                Citatu, June 30                                           a.  Cisendo nshi icafinisha icasendelwe na kapususha wesu mukwikala kwa mweo wakwe? Esaya 53:5–7; Luka 2:48, 49.
“Yesu asendele icisendo icafinisha ica kushingamwa ukwa kupususha abantu. Alishibe ukuti nga cakutifye takuli ukwalulwa ukwa bufumacumi [ubwafikapo] mufipope pamofye na mu mabukabilo aya mutundu wa muntu nse, ninshi fyonse fye fikaba ifya kulufiwa. Ici e cali e cisendo ca mweo wakwe kabili tapengaba nangu umo uwingomfwikisha ubufino ubwa bikilwe pali wena. Ukutulafye ku bwaice, kubupungwe pamofye naku bukalamba, akwete ukwenda fye eka. Nangula fye cali cakuti imyulu yaleba iya kuba mulubali lwakwe. Ubushiku no bushiku alekwata ukukumanya amesho pamofye na matunko; ubushiku no bushiku aleba uwakuletwa mukulolenkana no bubi, no kuba uwakukumanya amaka yabuko, pali abo bene abantu alefwaya ukupala elyo no kupususha. Nangu cali ifyo tafililwe atemwa ukunashiwa.
“Mu fintu fye fyonse apalamike amabukabilo yakwe mu bwampano ubwayana bwino ku mulimo wakwe. Acindamike umweo wakwe mu kulenga fyonse ifyaisanshishemo mu bwampano, ku bufwayo bwakwa wishi. Lintu ali mu bupungwe, banyina pakuba abakumusanga mwi sukulu lya bakafundisha, batile we mwana mulandu nshi watucushisha ifi?  Alikwete ukwasuka, no bwasuko bwakwe bwaisushiwemo ukushingamwa kwa mweo ukwa mulimo wakwe onse ubwa kuti; mulandu nshi mwacilamfwaila? Tamwishibe ukuti ningile ukubomba umulimo wakwa tata?
“Umweo wakwe wali mweo wa bulilambo uwa mukutwalilila. Takwete ne ng`anda muli cino icalo, ukucila pa nkumbu shafibusa abelekwata ukumutetesa ngo mupita nshilafye uwa pamakasa. Aishile mukwikala mulubali lwesu umweo wa kucucutika ukwabipisha, kabili no kuba uwakwenda pamofye no kubomba pakati ka babusu na balecula. Uwabula ukwishibikwa elyo no kucindikwa, aendawike konse-konse pakati kabantu abo abombelepo umulimo uu kalamba.”—Gospel Workers, pp. 42, 43.
b. 	Bushe ukufumfumuka kwakutemwa kwa kwa Lesa ukwa fulisha kuba ukwa kutufundisha shani ifwe pa cikumine shifwe wesu uwa mu mulu? Yohane 3:16; 1 Yohane 4:9, 10.
“ Ili ilambo ilikalamba talyacitilwe pakutila kube ukupanga ukutemwa kwa muntu  mu mutima wakwa wishi, atemwa ukumulenga ena abe uwakuipelesha ukupususha. Awe, awe! ‘Pantu Lesa atemenwe abapano isonde  ukutemwa ukwakuti apele umwa wakwe uwafyelwe eka’ Yohane 3:16. Shifwe alitutemwa ifwe, te pamulandu wa bundubulwila, lelo alikwete ukupela bundubulwila pa mulandu wakuti alikwata ukututemwa. Yesu ali ninshila iyali iya kubomfeshiwa ukupongolwela ukutemwa kwakwe ukwabula impela pa calo icawa. ‘Lesa ali muli Klistu  ukuba uwakuleta icalo kumwine eka.  ’ 2 Kolinto5:19. Lesa aculile pamo na mwane. Mukucucutika kwa mu Getisemani, ukufwa kwa pa kalfari, umutima uwakutemwa ukwabula impela kwalikwete ukulipila umutengo uwakulubulwa kwesu.”—Steps to Christ, p. 13

eng:
4. 	Our Substitute and Surety 	Wed, Jul 1
a. 	What is the basis of the salvation of our souls? 1 Corinthians 1:30; Acts 16:31.
“Oh, what soul hunger and longing had Christ to save that which was lost! The body crucified upon the cross did not detract from His divinity, His power of God to save through the human sacrifice, all who would accept His righteousness. In dying upon the cross, He transferred the guilt from the person of the transgressor to that of the divine Substitute through faith in Him as his personal Redeemer. The sins of a guilty world, which in figure are represented as ‘red as crimson,’ were imputed to the divine Surety.”—This Day With God, p. 236.
b. 	What did Christ do for our redemption that is beyond any human effort or wisdom? John 10:17; Romans 5:6–8.
‘My Father has so loved you that He even loves Me more for giving My life to redeem you. In becoming your Substitute and Surety, by surrendering My life, by taking your liabilities, your transgressions, I am endeared to My Father; for by My sacrifice, God can be just, and yet the justifier of him who believeth in Jesus.’
“None but the Son of God could accomplish our redemption; for only He who was in the bosom of the Father could declare Him. Only He who knew the height and depth of the love of God could make it manifest. Nothing less than the infinite sacrifice made by Christ in behalf of fallen man could express the Father’s love to lost humanity.”—Steps to Christ, p. 14.
c. 	What could John testify of our advocate at the throne of God? 1 John 1:1–3.
“There are but few who have an appreciation of the grievous character of sin, and who comprehend the greatness of the ruin that has resulted from the transgression of God’s law. By examining the wonderful plan of redemption to restore the sinner to the moral image of God, we see that the only means for man’s deliverance was wrought out by the self-sacrifice, and the unparalleled condescension and love of the Son of God. He alone had the strength to fight the battles with the great adversary of God and man, and, as our substitute and surety, He has given power to those who lay hold of Him by faith, to become victors in His name, and through His merits.”—Christian Education, p. 112.
bem:
4. CIFUTA MULANDU KABILI  ICA KWIKATILAMO [ICIKATILO] CESU                 Citatu, July 1
a. 	Lishintililo nshi Ilyepusukilo ilya mipashi Yesu? 1 Abena Kolinto 1:30; Imilimo ya Batumwa 16:31.
“Yangu, efyo kwali ukufwaisha no ku kabilisha kwa mupashi wakwa Klistu  ukwa kupususha ico icakwete ukuluba! Umubili uwakwete ukutanikwa pa capindama tawakwete ukuputulwa kuli buLesa bwakwe, amaka yakwe aya kwa Lesa aya kupususha ukupitila muli bulilambo bwa buntu; kuli bonse abakakwata ukupokelela ubulungami bwakwe. Mukukwata ukufwa pa capindama, alikwete ukusesha bu shimilandu ukufuma pa muntu uwali mpula-mafunde no kubutwala pali uyo uwali cikonsolwelo ca buLesa ukupila mu citetekelo muli uyo uwali ni kapususha wacila umo. Imembu sha calo ica milandu, ico mu fisontelelo cimininwako ne citatilo icakashika shalikwete ukutulikwa pali ici icikatilo ca buLesa”—This Day With God, p. 236.
b. 	Finshi Yesu akwete ukucita pa cikumine ukulubulwa kwesu uko ukwacila pa bwishibilo pamofye no kutukuta ukwa buntu? Yohane 10:17; Abena Abena Roma 5:6–8.
‘Tata aliba uwa kukutemwa imwe  kucifiko cakutila aliba uwakuntemwa ine ukucila  pa kupela umweo wandi ku kulubula imwe. Mukwisaba icifuta mulandu kabili icikatilo, ukupitila mukupela umweo wandi, na mukusenda ifisendo fyenu, na mampulu yenu, na lisaba uwa ku suminishiwa na tata; pa mulandu wakuti ukupitila mwilambo lyandi, Lesa kuti aba uwalungama kabili pamuku umo wine kalungamika wa uyo onse uwasumina muli Yesu.  ..’
“ Takuli umbi kanofye umwana uwakwa Lesa e wingakwata ukufikilisha ukulubulwa kwesu; pantu kanofye uyo uwali pa cifuba cakwa tata e winga mulondolola. Kanofye uyo uwishibe ukulepa pamofye no kushika ukwa kutemwa kwakwa Lesa e winga kulenga ukumoneka. Tapali cimbi ukucila pelambo ilyabula impela ilya citilwe na Klistu pa lubali lwa muntu uwawa ilingakwata ukulangisha ukutemwa kwakwa tata ku muntunse uwaluba.”—Steps to Christ, p. 14.
c. 	Finshi Yohane akwete ukupela ubunte pa cikumine   ndubulwila wesu pacipuna cabufumu icakwa kwa Lesa? 1 Yohane 1:1–3.
“Kwabafye abanono abakwata ukumfwikisha ukubipisha kwa mubelo wa mubembu, pamofye na bakwata ukukutuluka ubukalamba bwa boni ubwakwata ukutumbuka muli bumpula mafunde bwe funde lyakwa Lesa. Ukupitila  mukufwailisha  kwa bwanshiko ubwawamisha ubwa mutande wepusukilo uwa kubwesulushiwa kwa mubembu kucipasho cabololoke icabuLesa , kuti twamona ukutila, inshilafye imo iyakulubulwa  yakwete ukuletwa ukupitila mukuipela kwa bulilambo, pamofye no kusakamana elyo no kutemwa ukwa mwana wakwa Lesa. Ena ekafye e wakwete amaka yakushashala ne cibambe  [mulwani] mukalamba icakwa Lesa no muntu, kabili nge cikonsolwelo kabili ndubulwila wesu, alikwata ukupela amaka kuli abo abakwata ukwikatilila kuli wena ukupitila mucitetekelo , pakuti bengaba ba kacimfya mwishina lyakwe kabili no kupitila mu busuma bwakwe.”—Christian Education, p. 112.

eng:
5. 	Jesus Paid the Price 	Thu, Jul 2
a. 	What qualified Christ to pay the price of our redemption? 1 Peter 1:18, 19; Hebrews 5:8, 9.
“The price paid for our redemption, the infinite sacrifice of our heavenly Father in giving His Son to die for us, should give us exalted conceptions of what we may become through Christ. As the inspired apostle John beheld the height, the depth, the breadth of the Father’s love toward the perishing race, he was filled with adoration and reverence; and, failing to find suitable language in which to express the greatness and tenderness of this love, he called upon the world to behold it. . . . What a value this places upon man! Through transgression the sons of man become subjects of Satan. Through faith in the atoning sacrifice of Christ the sons of Adam may become the sons of God. By assuming human nature, Christ elevates humanity. Fallen men are placed where, through connection with Christ, they may indeed become worthy of the name ‘sons of God.’ ”—Steps to Christ, p. 15.
b. 	What words were used by the apostle John to express the magnitude of God’s love? 1 John 3:1, 2.
“Such love is without a parallel. Children of the heavenly King! Precious promise! Theme for the most profound meditation! The matchless love of God for a world that did not love Him! The thought has a subduing power upon the soul and brings the mind into captivity to the will of God. The more we study the divine character in the light of the cross, the more we see mercy, tenderness, and forgiveness blended with equity and justice, and the more clearly we discern innumerable evidences of a love that is infinite and a tender pity surpassing a mother’s yearning sympathy for her wayward child.”—Ibid., p. 15.
bem:
5. YESU ALILIPILE UMUTENGO                                                                          Cisano, 	July 2
a. 	Cinshi calengele Klistu ukuba uwalinga mukulipila umutengo wa kulubulwa kwesu? 1 Petelo 1:18, 19; Abahebele
“Umutengo uwalipilwe pa kulubulwa kwesu, ilambo ilyabula impela ilya kwa tata wesu uwa mu mulu mukuba uwakupela umwana wakwe ukwisa tufwila, cifwile ukutupela imyumfwile iyasumbukisha pafyo twingakwata ukuba ukupitila muli Klistu . Ngefyo umutumwa uwa putwamo Yohane, akwete ukumona ubutali pamo fye no kushika ukwa kutemwa kwakwa tata pa cikumine uluko ululeonaika, ali uwa kwisushiwamo no mucinshi pamofye na malumbo; kabili mukuba uwa kubulisha amashiwi ayali ayalinga mukukwata ukulondolola ubukalamba pamo fye no kutemwa ukwa ukutekanya kwakwe, ali uwakwishibisha icalo uku kwatafye ukukulolesha. Yangu we mutengo ici caba icakubika pa muntu! Ukupitila muli bumpula mafunde abana ba bantu baisa ba fipe fya kwa shetani. Ukupitila mu citetekelo mwilambo lya kukonsolwela ilya kwa Klistu abana bakwa adamu kuti bakwata ukusanguka abana bakwa Lesa. Ukupitila mukufwala imbela ya buntu nse, Yesu alikwata ukutumpula umuntu nse. Abantu abawa balikwata ukubikwa pancende apo, ukupitila mu bwampano na Klistu, mucine fye kuti baisa kwata ukuba abalinga ukwitwa abana baume abakwa Lesa’ ”—Steps to Christ, p. 15.
b. 	Mashiwi nshi ayakwete ukubomfya umutumwa Yohane ku kukwata ukulangisha ubufino bwa kutenwa kwakwa Lesa? 1 Yohane 3:1, 2.
“Kulya ukutemwa takwabako na kumbi ukwingalingana na kwena. Mwe bana ba mfumu ya myulu! Ubulayo ubu bukankala! kabili bwaba mulandu uwa kwetetulapo uu kankala! Ukutemwa ukushingalondololwa ukwa kwa Lesa pa calo ico ici sha mutemenwe!  Ilangulushi lyalikwata amaka aya kubumbulula pa mupashi kabili no kuleta ilangulushi kubusha bwa bufwayo bwakwa Lesa.   Mubwingi bwa kusambilila umubele wa buLesa mu lubuto lwa capindama, e mwaba ubwingi ubwa kumona uluse, ukutemwa elyo no kwelela ukwasanshiwamo no mulinganya elyo no bulungami, kabili efyo fiba ifya ku mwensekesha ubulekano bwa fishininkisho ifyakutemwa uko ukushakwata impela kabili no kusakamana uko ukwacila na kulya ukwakwa mayo fwe kuntu akwata pa mwana wakwe uyo uwakwata ukuluba.”—Ibid., p. 15

eng:

bem:
AMEPUSHO YA CILA UMO                                            Ubwalenga Mutanda, July 3
1. 	Londolola imibele iyo yabesha ii kankala iyo isangwa mu mubele wakwa Lesa.
2. 	Nishani Yesu akwete ukusokolola umubele wakwa Lesa lintu ali pesonde?
3.  	Nishani umulimo wakwa Klistu wakwete ulwambu pa mabusalo yakwe?
4. 	Pakuba cifuta mulandu wesu, masambililo nshi yantu Yesu akwata ukufundisha?

eng:
1. 	The Original State of Man 	Sun, Jul 5
a. 	Describe man’s original state in Eden. Genesis 1:26, 27, 31; Psalm 8:4–6.
“Man was originally endowed with noble powers and a well-balanced mind. He was perfect in his being, and in harmony with God. ”—Steps to Christ, p. 17.
“Man was to bear God’s image, both in outward resemblance and in character. Christ alone is ‘the express image’ (Hebrews 1:3) of the Father; but man was formed in the likeness of God. His nature was in harmony with the will of God. His mind was capable of comprehending divine things. His affections were pure; his appetites and passions were under the control of reason. He was holy and happy in bearing the image of God and in perfect obedience to His will.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 45.
b. 	How did Satan work to thwart the divine plan in the creation of man? Genesis 3:1–7; Romans 6:16; 1 John 2:16.
“Through disobedience, [man’s] powers were perverted, and selfishness took the place of love. His nature became so weakened through transgression that it was impossible for him, in his own strength, to resist the power of evil. He was made captive by Satan, and would have remained so forever had not God specially interposed. It was the tempter’s purpose to thwart the divine plan in man’s creation, and fill the earth with woe and desolation. And he would point to all this evil as the result of God’s work in creating man.”—Steps to Christ, p. 17.
bem:
1.  UMUBELO WA MUNTU UWA PAKUTENDEKA                                         Pali Cimo, July 5
a. 	Londolola umubelo wa muntu uwa pa kutendeka mu Eden. Ukutendeka 1:26, 27, 31; Amalumbo 8:4–6.
“Umuntu mukubalilapo apelwe amaka aya mano na malangulushi aya shikitala. Ali uwa pwililika, kabili mu bwampano na Lesa.” Steps to Christ, p. 17
“Umuntu ali no ku kwata icipasho cakwa Lesa kunse na mu mubelo. Yesu eka fye e waba icipasho cicine icakwa wishi [Abahebere 1:3]; nomba umuntu apangilwe fye mu cipasho cakwa Lesa. Imibele yakwe yali mu bwampano no bufwayo bwakwa Lesa. Amano yakwe yali aya kumfwikisha ifintu fya BuLesa. Imifwaile yakwe yali iya musangwela, insuna yakwe yali iya kutungululwa na kampingu. Ali uwa mushilo kabili uwa nsansa mu kukwata icipasho ca kwa Lesa kabili mukuba ne cumfwila ku bufwayo bwakwe.” Patriarchs and Prophets , p. 45
b. 	Nishani shetani akwete ukubomba ku konaula ubwanshiko bwa buLesa mu bubumbo bwa muntu? Ukutendeka 3:1–7; Abena Roma 6:16; 1 Yohane 2:16.
“Ukupitila mukubulisha icumfwila amaka ya muntu yalikwete ukonaulwa, kabili bukaitemwe bwalikwete ukusenda icifulo ca kutemwa. Umubelo wakwe  walishilekwata ukuba uwa kunashiwa ukupitila muli bumpula mafunde kucifiko cakuti, cali icashupisha palwakwe, mu makafye yakwe umwine ukuba uwa kucimfya amaka ya bubifi. Acitilwe umusha kuli shetani kabili ngalitwalililefye ukuba umusha nga cali cakutila Lesa tanyantukilemo [taiposelemo]. Bwali bukabilo bwakwa katunka ukuba uwakonaula ubwanshiko bwa buLesa ubwa kubumbwa kwa muntu no kuba uwa kwisusha icalo ne shamo pamofye no boni. Kabili nga alekwata ukusonta pali ubu bonse ububi nge catumbwikemo pa mulandu wakwa Lesa ukuba uwa kubumba umuntu.”—Steps to Christ, p. 17.

eng:
2. 	Fleeing From God’s Presence 	Mon, Jul 6
a. 	After their sin, how did Adam and Eve react when they heard the voice of God? Genesis 3:8–10.
b. 	Why are sinful human beings unable to stand in the presence of the Infinite One? Exodus 33:20; Deuteronomy 4:23, 24.
“In his sinless state, man held joyful communion with Him ‘in whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.’ Colossians 2:3. But after his sin, he could no longer find joy in holiness, and he sought to hide from the presence of God. Such is still the condition of the unrenewed heart. It is not in harmony with God, and finds no joy in communion with Him. The sinner could not be happy in God’s presence; he would shrink from the companionship of holy beings. Could he be permitted to enter heaven, it would have no joy for him. The spirit of unselfish love that reigns there—every heart responding to the heart of Infinite Love—would touch no answering chord in his soul. His thoughts, his interests, his motives, would be alien to those that actuate the sinless dwellers there. He would be a discordant note in the melody of heaven. Heaven would be to him a place of torture; he would long to be hidden from Him who is its light, and the center of its joy. It is no arbitrary decree on the part of God that excludes the wicked from heaven; they are shut out by their own unfitness for its companionship. The glory of God would be to them a consuming fire.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 17, 18.
b. 	Why is it impossible for man of himself to escape the penalty of sin? Job 14:4; Romans 8:7, 8; Isaiah 64:6.
“It is impossible for us, of ourselves, to escape from the pit of sin in which we are sunken. Our hearts are evil, and we cannot change them. ‘Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.’ Job 14:4. . . . Education, culture, the exercise of the will, human effort, all have their proper sphere, but here they are powerless. They may produce an outward correctness of behavior, but they cannot change the heart; they cannot purify the springs of life. There must be a power working from within, a new life from above, before men can be changed from sin to holiness. That power is Christ. His grace alone can quicken the lifeless faculties of the soul, and attract it to God, to holiness.”—Ibid., p. 18.
bem:
2. UKUFULUMUKA UKUFUMA KUNTANSHI YAKWA LESA                                 Cibili, July 6
a. 	lintu bakwata ukubembuka, ni shani Adamu na Eva bakwete ukucita lintu bakwete ukumfwa ishiwi lyakwa Lesa? Ukutendeka 3:8–10.
b. 	Mulandu nshi abantu nse ababembuka tabengakwatila ukwiminina kuntanshi yakwa uyo uu shakwata impela? Ukufuma 33:20; Amalango 4:23, 24.
“ Mumbela yakwe iya bulamo ulubembu, umuntu alikwete ubwampano ubwansansa noyo muntu mwaba umwakufisama ubukankala bonse ubwa kwiluka pamo fye no bwishibilo.’ Abena kolose 2:3. Lelo panuma ya kubembuka, tekuti abe uwa kutwalilila ukusanga insansa muli bumushilo bwakwe kabili akabilishe ukubelama ukufuma kumulola wakwe. Ulya ucili e mubelo uwa mutima uushila lengwa cipya-cipya. Nimukukana kwa bwampano na Lesa kabili no ku kanasanga insansa mu bwampano pamo nankwe. Umubembu tekuti abe uwansansa mukubapo kwakwa Lesa, eco akwatile no kuitalusha ukufuma mu bwampano bwa fibumbwa fya mushilo. Nga cali cakuti ali uwa kusuminshiwa ukwingila ku mulu, nga tacali icansansa kuli wena. Umupashi uwa bulamo bukaitemwe uu kwata ukutungulula kulya-  uko cila mutima, ukwata ukwankula ku mutima uwa kutemwa uwabula impela - tekuti fibe ifyakwtkatana no mupashi wakwe. Amatontonkanyo yakwe, amabukabilo yakwe, imifwaile yakwe ngafyalemoneka ifyeni kuli filya ifisangwa kubekashi ababula ulubembu abakulya. Nga ali ni kalufyanya wa bwampano busuma ubwaba mu myulu. Eico umulu ngawali kuli ena nincende ya kushikitika, lyonse fye ngaleba uwa kufwaisha ukuti engalaba uwa kufisama kumulola wa uyo uwali el ubuto lwakwe, kabili nge ntulo yansansa sha luko. Tacaba cipope icamucisha cinani icakwa Lesa icakukwata ukutamfya ababifi Ukufuma kumulu; lelo babafye abakuikanya abene pa mulandu fye wa kukanalinga kwabo ukwa bwampano bwakulya. Ululumbi ulwakwa Lesa nga lwali ngo mulilo uu lebilima kuli bena.  .”—Steps to Christ, pp. 17, 18.
c. 	Mulandu nshi cabela icashupisha umuntu pa lwakwe fye ukuba uwa kufulumuka icilambu ca lubembu? Yobo 14:4; Abena Roma 8:7, 8; Esaya 64:6.
“Caliba icayansha ifwe palwesu ukufulumuka ukufuma mucilindi calubembu umo muntu twakwata ukwibila. Imitima Yesu ya bubifi kabili tekuti tube abakuyalula. ‘Nani uwingafumya icintu icasanguluka mu cintu icakowela? Takuli nangu umo.’ Job 14:4. . . .amasambililo, intambi, ukubomfya kwabusalo, ukulwisha kwa buntu, fyonse fye fyalikwata ulwambu ulusuma, lelo tafyakwata amaka nangu yamo. Kuti fyakwanisha ukuleta ukulungika ukwa kunse ukwa mubele, lelo tekuti fibe ifyakwalula umutima. Tekuti fibe ifyakusangulula imilonga ya mweo. Kulingile ukubako amaka ayakwata ukubombela mukati, umweo upya uwakufuma kumulu, intanshi lintu abantu tabalaba abakwalulwa ukufuma kulubembu ukulola kuli bumushilo. Nayalya amaka ni Klistu. Icikuku cakwe cekafye e cingabukulusha ifikankala ifyafwa ifya mupashi no ku upalamika kuli Lesa, kuli bumushilo.”—Ibid., p.

eng:
3. 	The Need of a Saviour 	Tue, Jul 7
a. 	What must we realize about the human heart? Psalm 14:1–3; Romans 3:9–11.
“The Word of God declares, ‘All have sinned, and come short of the glory of God’ (Romans 3:23). ‘There is none that doeth good, no, not one’ (Romans 3:12). Many are deceived concerning the condition of their hearts. They do not realize that the natural heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked. They wrap themselves about with their own righteousness, and are satisfied in reaching their own human standard of character; but how fatally they fail when they do not reach the divine standard, and of themselves they cannot meet the requirements of God.”—Selected Messages, bk. 1, p. 320.
b. 	Why are we as human beings unable to discern the spiritual realm and see the kingdom of God? 1 Corinthians 2:14; 2 Corinthians 4:4.
“The Saviour said, ‘Except a man be born from above,’ unless he shall receive a new heart, new desires, purposes, and motives, leading to a new life, ‘he cannot see the kingdom of God.’ John 3:3, margin. The idea that it is necessary only to develop the good that exists in man by nature, is a fatal deception. ‘The natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.’ ‘Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.’ 1 Corinthians 2:14; 3:7. Of Christ it is written, ‘In Him was life; and the life was the light of men’—the only ‘name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.’ John 1:4; Acts 4:12.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 18, 19.
c. 	Although we cannot save ourselves, what can we do? Matthew 11:28–30; John 3:3.
“God was to be manifest in Christ, ‘reconciling the world unto Himself.’ 2 Corinthians 5:19. Man had become so degraded by sin that it was impossible for him, in himself, to come into harmony with Him whose nature is purity and goodness. But Christ, after having redeemed man from the condemnation of the law, could impart divine power to unite with human effort. Thus by repentance toward God and faith in Christ the fallen children of Adam might once more become ‘sons of God.’ 1 John 3:2.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 64.
bem:
3. UBUKABILO BWAKWA KLISTU                                                                                            Citatu, July 7
Cinshi tufwile twaba abaibukila pa cikumine umutima wa muntu nse? Amalumbo 14:1–3;  Abena Roman3:9–11.
“Ishiwi lyakwa Lesa lisosa ukuti,  ‘bonse na babembuka, kabili naba pelebelwa kubukata bwakwa Lesa’ (Abena Roma 3:23). ‘Takwaba nangu umo uu kwata ukucita icisuma, takwaba uuli onse’ (Abena Roma 3:12).  Abengi baliba abakufutikwa pa cikumine umubelo wa mitima yabo.  Tabakwata ukwiluka ukuti umutima mumbela wa uko waba uwakufutika ukucila ifintu fye fyonse, kabili waba uwabipisha. Balakwata ukuikupilisha abene beka no bulungami bwabo abene, kabili balakwata ukwikushiwa mukukwata ukufika pacifiko cabo ica cipimo ukulingana no munshinku wabo uwa bu muntu;  lelo ifyo mu busanso ubwingi balakwata ukufilwa ukufika pa cifiko ca mushinku wa buLesa kabili pa lwabofye abene tekuti bakwate ukufikilisha amabufwayo yakwa Lesa.”—Selected Messages, bk. 1, p. 320.
b. 	Mulandu nshi palwesu nga bantunse tatwabela abalinga ukuba abakulekanya ifisangwa mu cintengunwisha ca bumupashi elyo pamofye no kuba abalinga ukuba  aba kumona ubufumu bwakwa Lesa? 1 kolinto 2:14; 2 kolinto 4:4.
“kapususha asoasele ati, ‘nga cakutilafye umuntu tafyelwe ukufyalwa kwa kumulu,’nga cakutila fye  tapokelele umutima upya, amabukabilo ayapya, amabufwayo ayapya pamo fye ne myumfwile iipya , tekuti abe uwa kumona ubufumu bwa mu mulu.’ Yohane 3:3, ngeipelwe.  Ubwishibilo ubwakuti cili icikankala ukubafye abakulundulula ubusuma ubo ubukwata ukusangwa mu muntu ukupitila mu bubumbo bwakwe, bwaba kufutika ukwabusanso ubwingi. ‘Umuntu mu kubumbwa fye kwakwe  takwata ukukwanisha ukupokelela ifintu ifya mupashi wakwa Lesa: pantu ifi buwelewele kuli wena: kabili pa muku umowine tekuti abe uwa kufilekanya pa mulandu wakuti fyena fikwata ukulekanishiwa kuli bumupashi.’ ‘Mwipapuka pa mulandu wakuti nasosele ici kuli imwe.’ 1 kolinto 2:14; 3:7. Pacikumine Klistu calikwata ukulembwa aciti, muli wena e mwali umweo kabili umweo wali elubuto lwa bantu’— Ishina limofye mpo pesamba lya mulu, ilyapelwa pakati kabantu, emo tulingile ukupusukila.’ Yohane 1:4; Imilimo ya Batumwa 4:12.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 18, 19.
c. 	Nangula cakuti tekuti tube abakuipususha fwebene, finshi tulingile ukucita? Mateo 11:28–30; Yohane 3:3.
“Lesa  ali no kumonekela muli Klistu, ‘ukuba uwa kubwesulusha isonde ku mwine eka.’ 2 Kolinto 5:19. Umuntu alishilekwata ukuba uwa kutotobela no lubembu kucifiko cakuti calishilekwata ukuba icayafya palwakwe, mumbela yakwe ukwisaba mu bwampano no yo untu imbela yakwe nibu musangwela pamofye no busuma. Lelo Klistu  pakuba uwa kulubula umuntu ukufuma  mukusekwa nefunde, nomba kuti aba uwa kupampamika  amaka ya buLesa mukukwata ukwampana no kulwisha kwa bumuntu.  Eico ukupitila mukulapila ukwa kubwelela kuli Lesa pamo fye ne citetekelo muli Klistu abana abawa abakwa Adam kuti na kabili line baba bakwisaba abana baume abakwa Lesa.  .’ 1 Yohane 3:2.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 64.

eng:
4. 	The Sinner’s Supplication 	Wed, Jul 8
a. 	What was the apostle Paul’s problem when he came to a full knowledge of his state as a sinner before God? Romans 7:12, 14, 24.
“It is not enough to perceive the lovingkindness of God, to see the benevolence, the fatherly tenderness, of His character. It is not enough to discern the wisdom and justice of His law, to see that it is founded upon the eternal principle of love. Paul the apostle saw all this when he exclaimed, ‘I consent unto the law that it is good.’ ‘The law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.’ But he added, in the bitterness of his soul-anguish and despair, ‘I am carnal, sold under sin.’ Romans 7:16, 12, 14. He longed for the purity, the righteousness, to which in himself he was powerless to attain, and cried out, ‘O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from this body of death?’ Romans 7:24, margin. Such is the cry that has gone up from burdened hearts in all lands and in all ages. To all, there is but one answer, ‘Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.’ John 1:29.”—Steps to Christ, p. 19.
“There are many who realize their helplessness, and who long for that spiritual life which will bring them into harmony with God; they are vainly striving to obtain it. . . . The Saviour is bending over the purchase of His blood, saying with inexpressible tenderness and pity, ‘Wilt thou be made whole?’”—The Desire of Ages, p. 203.
b. 	By what means was Jacob assured by God that he was not forsaken when he fled from his brother Esau? Genesis 28:10–13.
“[Jacob] felt that he was an outcast, and he knew that all this trouble had been brought upon him by his own wrong course. The darkness of despair pressed upon his soul, and he hardly dared to pray. But he was so utterly lonely that he felt the need of protection from God as he had never felt it before. With weeping and deep humiliation he confessed his sin, and entreated for some evidence that he was not utterly forsaken. Still his burdened heart found no relief. He had lost all confidence in himself, and he feared that the God of his fathers had cast him off.
“But God did not forsake Jacob. His mercy was still extended to His erring, distrustful servant. The Lord compassionately revealed just what Jacob needed—a Saviour. He had sinned, but his heart was filled with gratitude as he saw revealed a way by which he could be restored to the favor of God.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 183.
bem:
4. 	UKUPAPATA KWA MUBEMBU                                                                        Cine, July 8
a. Bwafya nshi ubwakwete Paulo lintu aishile kwata ukuba uwakufika pa bwishibilo ubwafikapo ubwakumine imbela yakwe ngo mubembu kuntanshi yakkwa Lesa? Abena Roma 7:12, 14, 24.
“Tacaba icafikapo ukukwatafye imyumfwile ya nkumbu iya kutemwa isha kwa Lesa, atemwa ukukwatafye ukumona ukusakamana kakwe, nangula icilela ca bufyashi ica mubele wakwe. Tacaba icafikapo ukukwatafye ukulekanya ubwishibilo pamo fye no bololoke ubwefunde lyakwe, ukumona ukwa kuti lyakwata ukushintilila pa cipope ica muyayaya ica kutemwa. Paulo umutumwa akwete ukumona ifi fyonse lintu akwete ukubilikisha ati, ninkwata ukusuminisha kwifunde ilyaba ilisuma.’ ‘ Amalango ya mushilo ne funde lya mushilo lya lilungama kabili lisuma. Lelo alikwete ukukonkanyapo muku kalipwa no kulunguluka kwa mupashi na mukupelebelwa atila; ndi mubembu uwa shitishiwa  kulubembu’ Abena Roma 7:16, 12, 14. Akabilishe ukusanguluka, ubulungami ubo buntu palwakwe ali uwabulisha amaka ukubukwata, akwete ukulila, ‘yangu ne muntu wankumba bulili fintu nakwata ukuba, ‘nani engandubula ukufuma ku mubili uyu uwa mfwa?’ Abena Roma 7:24, ngeipelwe. Uku e kwali ekulila uko ukwakwete ukufuma ku mitima mu ncende fye shonse kabili mu nkulo fye shonse. Nakuli bonse, takululi ubwasuko bumbi ukucila pa bwakuti, ‘moneni umwana wampanga uwakwa Lesa uulesenda ulubembu lwa calo. ’ Yohane 1:29.”—Steps to Christ, p. 19.
“Kuli abengi  abakwata ukukutuluka ukubulisha kwa maka ya kuyafwa abene, kabili abakwata ukukabilisha ulya umweo wa bumupashi  uyo uwingakwata ukubaleta mu bwampano na Lesa; Lelo nomba balakwata ukutulukusha ku kukwata… Kapususha alekwata ukuba mupepi-pepi no mutengo wa mulopa wakwe , no kusosa no kutemwa pamo fye no kusakamana ukushingalondololwa, ati, ‘bushe ulefwaya ukuposhiwa’?’”—The Desire of Ages, p. 203.
b. 	Kupitila munshila nshi muntu Yakobo ali uwa kupelelwamo ubulayo kuli Lesa ukuti  tali uwalekeleshiwa litu akwete ukufulumuka ukufuma kuli ndume nankwe? Ukutendeka 28:10–13.
“[Yakobo] ayumfwile ukuba uwalekeleshiwa, no kuba uwakwishiba ukuti uku konse ukumanama kwaishile pali wena pa mulandu ya mibombele yakwe iyali iyabipa. Imfifi iya kulanguluka yalikwete ukutitikisha umweo wakwe, eico ilingiline alefilwa ukupepa. Lelo akwete fye ukuba eka kucifiko cakuti akwete ukumfwa ubukabilo bwa bucingo ubwakufuma kuli Lesa buntu tatalile uku mfwapo kunshita yakununa. Ne misoshi [ne filamba] pamofye no kuitula ukwashika, akwete ukutumbula ulubembu lwakwe, no kuba uwakulomba icishininkisho icakulangisha ukuti mu cinefye takwete ukulekeleshiwa. Nangula cakwete ukuba ifi, umutima wakwe uwali uwa fininwa tawakwete ukusanga ukupepemuka. Alikwete ukulusa fye isubilo lyonse muli buine, kabili alikwete ukutina ukuti Lesa wa fikolwe alikwete ukumuposa.
“Lelo Lesa takwete ukumufutuka. Uluse lwakwe lwalitwalilile ukutambalikilwa ku mubomfi wakwe uyu uwaluba uwali uwa bulisha icitetekelo. Mukusakamana shikulu alisokolwele cilya cintu Yakobo alekabila— icali ni kapususha. Alikwete ukubembuka, lelo umutima wakwe walikwete ukwisushiwamo ne nsansa lintu akwete ukumona inshila yakwete ukusokololwa iyo intu ali no kubwesulushiwamo kububile bwakwa Lesa”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 183.

eng:
5. 	Connecting Heaven and Earth 	Thu, Jul 9
a. 	What is the lesson to be learned from the ladder that Jacob saw in the wilderness? Genesis 28:16, 17; John 1:51.
“In this vision the plan of redemption was presented to Jacob, not fully, but in such parts as were essential to him at that time. The mystic ladder revealed to him in his dream was the same to which Christ referred in His conversation with Nathanael. [John 1:51 quoted]. Up to the time of man’s rebellion against the government of God, there had been free communion between God and man. But the sin of Adam and Eve separated earth from heaven, so that man could not have communion with his Maker. Yet the world was not left in solitary hopelessness. The ladder represents Jesus, the appointed medium of communication.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 184.
b. 	Describe the connection that Christ’s mediation has established. Romans 3:23–26; Hebrews 1:14.
“In the apostasy, man alienated himself from God; earth was cut off from heaven. Across the gulf that lay between, there could be no communion. But through Christ, earth is again linked with heaven. With His own merits, Christ has bridged the gulf which sin had made, so that the ministering angels can hold communion with man. Christ connects fallen man in his weakness and helplessness with the Source of infinite power.”—Steps to Christ, p. 20.
“The heart of God yearns over His earthly children with a love stronger than death. In giving up His Son, He has poured out to us all heaven in one gift. The Saviour’s life and death and intercession, the ministry of angels, the pleading of the Spirit, the Father working above and through all, the unceasing interest of heavenly beings—all are enlisted in behalf of man’s redemption.”—lbid., p. 21.
bem:
5. 	UKUMINKANYA UMULU NE SONDE                                                         Cisano, July 9   . “Lisambililo nshi ilyakusambilila ukufuma ku mutanto untu Yakobo akwete ukumona mu matololo? Ukutendeka 28:16, 17; Yohane 1:51.
“ Muli ici ici icimonwa umutande we pusukilo walikwete ukulangishiwa kuli Yakobo, tawalangishiwe umupwilapo lelo kano, ifiputulwa fye filya ifyakwete ukuba ifikankala pali ilya ine inshita. Uyu umutanto uwali cankama, wakwete ukusokolwelwa kuli wena mu ciloto cakwe, walifye mutanto umo wine untu Klistu alekwata ukusontelelako mukulanshanya kwakwe na Natanaeli (Nathanael). [Yohane 1:51 ngeipelwe]. Ukusukilafye ukufika na pa nshita lintu umuntu ali uwakuba uwa kusangukila ubutungulushi bwakwa Lesa, kwalifye ubwampano apashali icakucilinganya icili conse pakati ka kwa Lesa no muntu. Lelo ulubembu lwakwa Adamu na Eva lwakwete ukupatukanya umulu ne sonde, pakutila fye umuntu engapusulwa mukukwata ubwampano na kabumba wakwe. Nangu cali muli uyu umusango, isonde talyakwete ukushiwa ukwabula isubilo ilili lyonse. Umutanto wimininako Yesu, uwaba nge nshila iya sontwa iya kulanshanishishanyamo.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 184.
b. 	Londolola bundubulwila bwa kwa Klistu buntu bwakwata ukupampamika. Abena Roma 3:23–26; Abahebele 1:14.
“Mu busangu, umuntu aishileba uwakuitalusha ukufuma kuli Lesa; isonde lyaishile kwata ukuputulwa Ukufuma ku mulu. Pakati ka muyenge uwakwata ukuba uwa kucilinganya, tekuti pabe ubwampano. Lelo ukupitila muli Klistu, isonde na kabili line lyalikwata ukulundinkashiwa no mulu. No bololoke bwakwe umwine, Klistu  alikwata ukupanga ubulalo pa muyenge untu ulubembu lwakwete ukupanga, pa kutila abangeli abakwata ukupyungila bengaba abakwikatilila ubwampano no muntu.  Klistu alaba uwa kulundanya umuntu uwawa mukubulisha amaka kwakwe pamofye na mukubulwa ukwafwiwa ne ntuntuko ya maka ayashakwata impela.”—Steps to Christ, p. 20.
“Umutima wakwa Lesa  ulakwata ukupapata abana bakwe aba pesonde no kutemwa ukwaba ukwakosa ukucila nenfwa. Ukupitila mukupela umwana wakwe, aliba uwa kwitulula kuli baifwe umulu fye onse mu cabupe fye cimo---Icili  mweo wakwa kapususha pamo fye ne mfwa kabili na bukupapatila, umulimo  wa bangeli, ukupapata kwa mupashi, tata uulekwata ukubomba mu mulu kabili ukupitila muli  bonse, ukusakamana ukushakwata impela ukwa fibumbwa fya mu mulu—Aba bonse bali isanshamo mulubali lwepusukilo lya muntu.”—lbid., p. 21.

eng:
1. 	Sorrow for Sin 	Sun, Jul 12
a. 	What evidence of true repentance was demanded by John the Baptist? Luke 3:7–14.
“Repentance includes sorrow for sin and a turning away from it. We shall not renounce sin unless we see its sinfulness; until we turn away from it in heart, there will be no real change in the life.”—Steps to Christ, p. 23.
b. 	What should be known about true repentance that changes the heart and life? 2 Corinthians 7:9, 10.
“Real sorrow for sin is the result of the working of the Holy Spirit. The Spirit reveals the ingratitude of the heart that has slighted and grieved the Saviour, and brings us in contrition to the foot of the cross. By every sin Jesus is wounded afresh; and as we look upon Him whom we have pierced, we mourn for the sins that have brought anguish upon Him. Such mourning will lead to the renunciation of sin.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 300.
“When the heart yields to the influence of the Spirit of God, the conscience will be quickened, and the sinner will discern something of the depth and sacredness of God’s holy law, the foundation of His government in heaven and on earth.”—Steps to Christ, p. 24.
bem:
1. 	UBULANDA PALUBEMBU                                                                    Pali Cimo, July 12
a. 	 Cishininkisho nshi icakulapila ukwa cine ukwalekabilwa na Yohane Kabatisha? Luka 3:7–14.
“Mukulapila mwaba ukumfwa kwa bulanda ukwa pa lubembu no kukwata ukufuma kuli ulo lubembu. Tekuti tube abakuleka ulubembu kano fye nga twakwata ukumona ububi bwaluko. Nga cakutila fye tatuli abakuleka ulo ulubembu ninshi takuli ukwalulwa ukwa cine mu mweo.  .”—Steps to Christ, p. 23.
b. 	Finshi filingile ukwishibwa pa cikumine ukulapila ukwacishinka uko ukwalula umutima no mweo? 2 Kolinto7:9, 10.
“Ukumfwa ubulanda pa lubembu ukwa cine kwaba e cisabo icakubomba kwa mupashi wa mushilo. Umupashi ukwata ukusokolola ukubulisha kwakutasha ukwa mutima uko ukwakwata ukwangusha no kusakamika kapususha, no kutuleta ifwe mukulila ukwa kulepuka kwa mitima pesamba lya ca capindama. Pali cila lubembu ulukwata ukucitwa Klistu alaba uwa kucenwa mu mubili wakwe na kabili; kabili lintu tuleba abakulolesha pali uyo untu twaba aba kulasaula tulaba abakulosha pa membu isho ishakwata ukuleta ukushikitika pali wena kabili ni ukukwine ukulosha e kuli no kuleta ukuleka kwa lubembu.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 300.
“Lintu umutima waba uwakuletwa pesamba lya lwambu lwa mupashi wakwa Lesa, kampingu alaba uwa kwalamushiwa kabili no mubembu alakwata ukulekanya cimo icashika kabili ica mushilo icili lifunde ilya mushilo ilyakwa Lesa, ilyaba e mufula uwa butungulushi bwakwe mu mulu.”—Steps to Christ, p. 24.

eng:
2. 	Sincere Repentance 	Mon, Jul 13
a. 	What was David’s plea when he realized the weight of his guilt? Psalm 51:1–4.
“The prayer of David after his fall, illustrates the nature of true sorrow for sin. His repentance was sincere and deep. There was no effort to palliate his guilt; no desire to escape the judgment threatened, inspired his prayer. David saw the enormity of his transgression; he saw the defilement of his soul; he loathed his sin. It was not for pardon only that he prayed, but for purity of heart. He longed for the joy of holiness—to be restored to harmony and communion with God.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 24, 25.
b. 	What did the true repentance of David lead him to seek? Psalm 51:10–13.
“ ‘Create in me a clean heart.’ This is beginning right, at the very foundation of Christian character; for out of the heart are the issues of life. If all, ministers and people, would see to it that their hearts are right with God, we should see much larger results from the labor put forth. The more important and responsible your work, the greater the necessity that you have clean hearts. The needed grace is provided, and the power of the Holy Spirit will work with every effort you make in this direction. If every child of God would seek Him earnestly and perseveringly, there would be a greater growth in grace. Dissensions would cease; believers would be of one heart and one mind; purity and love would prevail in the churches. By beholding, we become changed. The more you contemplate the character of Christ, the more you will become conformed to His image. Come to Jesus just as you are, and He will receive you, and put a new song in your mouth, even praise to God.”—Gospel Workers, (1892/1893 edition), pp. 451, 452.
c. 	What does the Bible teach about repentance and full surrender to Christ? Romans 2:4; Acts 3:19; 5:31.
“We can no more repent without the Spirit of Christ to awaken the conscience than we can be pardoned without Christ.
“Christ is the source of every right impulse. He is the only one that can implant in the heart enmity against sin. Every desire for truth and purity, every conviction of our own sinfulness, is an evidence that His Spirit is moving upon our hearts.”—Steps to Christ, p. 26.
bem:
2. 	UKULAPILA UKWA CINE                                                                                     Cibili, July 13
a. 	Kupapata nshi ukwali ukwa kwa Dabidi lintu aishile kwata ukumfwikisha ubufino bwa bushi milandu bwakwe? Amalumbo 51:1–4.
“Ipepo lyakwa Dabidi  panuma ya kuwa kwakwe, likwata ukulondolola imbela ya kumfwa kwa bulanda pa lubembu ukwa cine. Ukulapila kwakwe kwali ukwa cine kabili ukwa shika. Takwaliko ukulwisha ukuli konse ukwa kuwaminisha bushimilandu bwakwe; takwali ubukabilo ubwaku fulumuka ubupingushi ubwalekwata ukupampamikwa pali wena ubwali ubwakutinya, ifi te fyakoselesha ipepo lyakwe. Dabidi akwete fye ukumona ukubipa kwa lubembu lwakwe; alikwete ukumona ukukoweshiwa kwa mweo wakwe; akwete ukutunga ulumbu lwakwe ukuba ulwamakankamike. Takwete ukupepa pa kutila fye akwate ukwelelwa lelo apepele na pakuti akwate ukusangululwa umutima. Akabilishe insansa sha bu mushilo uko ukwali kubwesulushiwa kubwampano na Lesa.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 24, 25.
b. 	Bushe ukulapila ukwa cine ukwa kwa Dabidi kwa mutungulwile ku ku fwaya finshi? Amalumbo 51:10–13.
“ ‘Lengeni muli ine umutima uupya.’ Uku e kutendeka ukwa yana pa mufula wine wine uwa mubele wa bwina Klistu ; Pantu kufuma mucipao ca mutima umo mukwata ukufuma amafya yamweo. Nga cakutila bonse, bakakumba na bantu bonse capamo, benga kwata ukumona ukuti imitima yabo yaba iyabololoke kuli Lesa, tulingile ukumomona ififumamo ifikalamba ukufuma ku maka ayakwata ukubikwamo. Ifili ubukankala no kushingamwa ukwa mulimo obe, e cili icafwaikwa sana ukuti mube ne mutima iya iyasambwa [iya sanguluka.] icikuku icilekabilwa cilakwata ukupelwa kabili na maka aya mupashi wa mushilo fikakwata ukubombela pamo na maka ukubikako muli iyi nshila. Nga caba cakuti cila mwana uwakwa Lesa aba uwa kumufwaya mu mukosha kabili mukutwalilila, kuli no kuba ukulunduluka ukukalamba mu cikuku. Ukupatulukana kuli no kupwa; abasumini bali no kuba aba mutima umo ne langulushi limo; ukusanguluka no kutemwa fili no kumoneka mu filonganino. Ukupitila mukulolesha, tulakwata ukuba aba kwalulwa. Mubwingi bwa kwetetula umubele wakwa Klistu e kufula kwa kulola kuku kwata icipasho cakwe. Isa kuli Yesu ifyo fine fintu uli, kabili alakwata ukukupokelela no kuba uwakubika ulwimbo lupya mukanwa kobe, pamo fye na malumbo kuli Lesa.”—Gospel Workers, (1892/1893 edition), pp. 451, 452.
c. 	Bushe icipingo cikwata ukufundisha shani pa cikumine ukulapila elyo pamofye no kucimba umupwilapo kuli Klistu? Abena Roma 2:4; Imilimo ya Batumwa 3:19; 5:31.
“Tekuti tube abakukwanisha ukulapila ukwabula umupashi wakwa Klistu  ukwalamusha kampingu ngefyo fye tekuti tube abakukwanisha ukwelelwa ukwabula Klistu .
“Klistu  aba entuntuko lya kwa kampingu onse uwa lungama. Ena ekafye e wingakwata ukubika mukati ka mutima ubulwani ubwa kupata ulubembu. Ubukabilo bonse ubwa cine na bumusangwela, ukushininwa konse ukwa mbela yesu iya lubembu, caba cishininkisho icakuti umupashi wakwe ulekwata ukubomba pa mitima.”—Steps to Christ, p

3. 	False Repentance 	Tue, Jul 14
a. 	What was the nature of the repentance of Esau, Pharaoh and Judas when they realized the consequences of their sin? Hebrews 12:16, 17; Exodus 12:30–32; 14:3–5; Matthew 27:3–5.
“Multitudes sorrow that they have sinned and even make an outward reformation because they fear that their wrongdoing will bring suffering upon themselves. But this is not repentance in the Bible sense. They lament the suffering rather than the sin. Such was the grief of Esau when he saw that the birthright was lost to him forever. . . . Judas Iscariot, after betraying his Lord, exclaimed, ‘I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood.’ Matthew 27:4.
“The confession was forced from his guilty soul by an awful sense of condemnation and a fearful looking for of judgment. The consequences that were to result to him filled him with terror, but there was no deep, heartbreaking grief in his soul, that he had betrayed the spotless Son of God and denied the Holy One of Israel. Pharaoh, when suffering under the judgments of God, acknowledged his sin in order to escape further punishment, but returned to his defiance of Heaven as soon as the plagues were stayed. These all lamented the results of sin, but did not sorrow for the sin itself.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 23, 24.
“God gave to Pharaoh the most striking evidence of divine power, but the monarch stubbornly refused to heed the light. Every display of infinite power rejected by him, rendered him the more determined in his rebellion. The seeds of rebellion that he sowed when he rejected the first miracle, produced their harvest.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 268.
b. 	What happens when a sinner does not repent and delays his repentance until some future time? John 12:35, 36; Hebrews 3:12–15.
“Those professed Christians who come up to that last fearful conflict unprepared will, in their despair, confess their sins in words of burning anguish, while the wicked exult over their distress. These confessions are of the same character as was that of Esau or of Judas. Those who make them, lament the result of transgression, but not its guilt. They feel no true contrition, no abhorrence of evil. They acknowledge their sin, through fear of punishment; but, like Pharaoh of old, they would return to their defiance of Heaven should their judgments be removed.”—The Great Controversy, pp. 620, 621.[Author’s italics.]
bem:
3. 	UKULAPILA UKWA BUFI                                                                  Citatu, July 14
a. 	Yali ni mbela nshi iya kulapila kwakwa Esao, farao elyo na Yuda lintu baishile kwata ukukutuluka kwa fya kutumbuka ifyali no kufuma mu membu shabo? Abahebele 12:16, 17; Ukufuma 12:30–32; 14:3–5; Mateo 27:3–5
“Abengi balakwata ukumfwa ubulanda pa mulandu wakuti na baba abakukwata ukubembuka  no kubafye abakulangisha ukwalulwa  ukwa  kunse pa mulandu wakuti balakwata ukutina fye ukuti ici citwa cabo icabipa cintu bali abakucita kuti cakwata ukubaletela ukucula. Lelo uku tekulapila ukwabufwayo bwa cipingo. Balakwata ukulila akalanda pa mulandu wabucushi mucifulo cakulilishika pa lubembu. Ubu ebwali e bulanda bwakwa Esao panuma yakukwata ukumona ukuti insambu shakwe ishabubeli na shikwata ukupokwa umupwilapo….yuda sikalyote, panuma yaku futuka shikulu wakwe, alilile ukuti;  ni mbembuka pa mulandu wakuti ninkwata ukufutuka umulopa uwa kaele’ Mateo 27:4.
“Ukuyebelela kwalipatikishiwe Ukufuma ku mweo wakwe uyo uwali uwa mulandu ukupitila mukumfwa ukwa kesekwa kabili na pa kulolesha pa bupingushi ubo ubwakutinya. Ifyakutumbukamo ifyo ifyali no kumuponekela fyakwete ukumwisushamo no mwenso, lelo takwali ukwashika ukumfwa kwa bulanda uko ukufwaikwa ukwa kutobeka kwa mutima mu mweo wakwe, ukwakuti akwete ukufutuka umwana wakwa Lesa uwakaele kabili no kuba uwa kukana uwa mushilo wakwa Israeli. Farao lintu alekwata ukucucutika pesamba lyama bupingushi [finkunka] fyakwa Lesa, alishile kwata ukusumina ulubembu lwakwe pa kutilafye engaba uwa kufulumuka ukulimunwa ukwali no kukonkapo, lelo akwete ukubwelela ku kupinkana no mululu ilyoline fye lintu ifinkunka fyaishilekwata ukufumishiwapo. Aba bonse balilile akalanda kufitumbuka ukufuma mulubembu, lelo tabaumfwile ubulanda palubembu lwine.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 23, 24.
“Lesa apele kuli Farao icishininkisho icamaka ya buLesa ayo ayali aya kwalamusha, lelo iyi mfumu mukutakalala yakwete ukukana ukumfwa kulubuto. Ukulangishiwa konse ukwa maka ayabula mpela ayakwete ukupililikwa nankwe, ya mulengele ena ukuba uwa kukoselako fye mubusangu bwakwe. Imbuto sha busangu shintu akwete ukubyala lintu akwete ukukana icisungusho icakubalilapo, fyaletele ubusomboshi bwafiko pakapeleko.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 268.
b. 	Finshi ficitika lintu umubembu talekwata ukulapila no kubafye uwakushinga-shingisha ukulapila kwakwe ukusunkila kunshita imbi iya ku ntanshi? Yohane 12:35, 36; Aba hebele 3:12–15.
“Bonse abo abakwata ukutungwa nga abena Klistu, abakwata  ukwisa ku bulwi ubwa kulekelesha ukwabula ukuipekanishisha, munshita ya kupelelwa kwabo, bakwata ukutumbula imembu shabo mu mashiwi ayakulilishika  ukwingi, elyo kulubali lumbi  umubifi akwata ukusansamuka mukupelelwa kwabo. Uku ukutumbula kwa membu kuli mumbela imo ine ngakulya kwine ukwa kwa Esao elyo na Yuda. Abo abakwata ukulila akalanda pafya kutumbuka muli bumpula mafunde lelo tepalubembu u lwine, tabakwata ukumfwa ubulanda ulwa cishinka atemwa ukuleka ububi. Balakwata ukusumina imembu shabo ukupitila fye mukukwata umwenso uwa kulimunwa; lelo nga Farao wakale balakwata ukubwelela ku kupinkana no mulu nga casangwa fye ukuti amabupingushi ayo na yakwata ukufumishiwapo.”—The Great Controversy, pp. 620, 621.[Author’s italics.]

eng:
4. 	The Pharisee and the Publican 	Wed, Jul 15
a. 	What is the difference between the Pharisee and the publican in Christ’s story? Luke 18:10–13.
“In the parable of the Pharisee and the publican, the self-sufficient prayer, ‘God, I thank Thee that I am not as the rest of men,’ stood out in sharp contrast to the penitent’s plea, ‘Be merciful to me the sinner.’ Luke 18:11, 13, R. V., margin. Thus Christ rebuked the hypocrisy of the Jews.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 495.
b. 	What did Jesus say about the result of the publican’s prayer? Luke 18:14.
“The poor publican who prayed, ‘God be merciful to me a sinner’ (Luke 18:13), regarded himself as a very wicked man, and others looked upon him in the same light; but he felt his need, and with his burden of guilt and shame he came before God, asking for His mercy. His heart was open for the Spirit of God to do its gracious work and set him free from the power of sin. The Pharisee’s boastful, self-righteous prayer showed that his heart was closed against the influence of the Holy Spirit. Because of his distance from God, he had no sense of his own defilement, in contrast with the perfection of the divine holiness. He felt no need, and he received nothing.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 30, 31.
c. 	In telling this story, what destructive attitude was Jesus seeking to correct? Luke 18:9; 2 Corinthians 10:12; Proverbs 16:18.
“The religion of the Pharisee does not touch the soul. He is not seeking Godlikeness of character, a heart filled with love and mercy. He is satisfied with a religion that has to do only with the outward life. His righteousness is his own—the fruit of his own works—and judged by a human standard.
“Whoever trusts in himself that he is righteous, will despise others. As the Pharisee judges himself by other men, so he judges other men by himself. His righteousness is estimated by theirs, and the worse they are the more righteous by contrast he appears. His self-righteousness leads to accusing. ‘Other men’ he condemns as transgressors of God’s law. Thus he is making manifest the very spirit of Satan, the accuser of the brethren. With this spirit it is impossible for him to enter into communion with God.”—Christ’s Object Lessons, p. 151.
bem:
4. 	UMUFARISEI  ELYO NO MUSANGUSHI                                                          Cine  July 15
a. 	Bupusano nshi ubwaba pakati ka mufarise elyo no musangushi mu Mulumbe wakwa Klistu? Luka 18:10–13.
“Mu mulumbe wa Mufarise elyo no musangushi, lilya ipepo ilya kuyuma pacifuba ilyakuti, ‘Lesa, na kutotela pantu nshaba nga bantu bambi,’ Aiminine kukupusanako no ku kupapata ukwakulapila uko ukwali ukwa kungatana  ukwa kuti, ‘Umbelele uluse ine ne mubembu.’ Luka 18:11, 13, R. V., ngeipelwe. Eico Klistu aebawile bumumbi munda bwaba Yuda.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 495.
b. 	Finshi Yesu aeseshe ukusosapo pa cikumine icafumine mwipepo lya musangushi? Luka 18:14.
“Umusangushi uwali umubusu apepele ukuti, ‘Umbelele uluse we Lesa’ (Luka 18:13), aimwene umwine eka ukuba muntu umubifi ukucila, pa muku umo wine, na bantu bambi balekwata uku mumona mumbela imo ine; lelo aumfwile ubukabilo bwakwe, eico pamo ne cisendo cakwe icakuyumfwa uwa milandu kabili uwasebana, aishile kuntanshi yakwa Lesa no kuba  uwakulomba uluse. Umutima wakwe wali uwaisuka mukusuminisha umupashi wakwa Lesa ukubomba umulimo wa uko uwa cikuku kabili no kuba uwakulubulwa ukufuma ku maka ya lubembu. Ukuyuma kwa pa cifuba pamofye ne citutumushi icakuibika umulungami kuli uyu umufarise kwalangishe ukuti umutima wakwe wali uwaisamika kulwambu lwa mupashi wa mushilo.  Na pamulandu wakuba ukutali Ukufuma kuli Lesa, takwete no kuba uwa kukutuluka uku kowela kwakwe, mukupusanako no kupwililika ukwa mushilo wa buLesa. Takwete ukuyumfwa bulya bukukabila eico takwatile ukupokelela icili conse.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 30, 31.
c. 	Mukuba uwakupela uyu umulumbe, mubele nshi uwabipisha untu Yesu alekabilisha ukulungika? Luka 18:9; 2 Kolinto10:12; Amapinda 16:18.
“Imipepele ya Mu Farisei taikwata ukwalamusha umweo. Talekabila umubele wa buLesa, umutima uwaisushiwamo no kutemwa elyo no luse. Ali uwaikushiwa ne mipepele iyo iikwata ukubomba fye no mweo wanku nse epela. Ubulungami bwakwe bwalifye bwa kuikwatila— icali cisabo ica milimo yakwe fye— kabili iipimwa necipimo ca munshinku wa bu muntu.
“Uyo onse uukwata ukuicetekela umwine eka ukuti mulungami, alakwata ukususha bambi, ngafilya fine umu farisei alekwata ukuilinga ku abantu bambi, efyo nao akwata ukulinga ku bantu bambi.  Ubulungami bwakwe bukwata ukulingwa mu bulungami bwabo, eico ilyo ukubipisha kwa abo ailingamo kwata uku kulisha efyo ena esa mukuimona umulungami sana ukucila bena. Ubulungai bwakwe ubwakuikwatila butungulula ku kufwailisha kwa filubo. ‘Abantu bambi’ ebo alepingula ukuba ni bakatoba befunde lyakwa Lesa. Eico nomba alekwata ukulangisha fye pambili-bili umupashi umo wine fye uwa kwasatana uwaba ni kashinina wa bamunyina. Eico ukuba no yu umupashi cili icashupisha ena ukwingila mu bwampano pamo na Lesa.”—Christ’s Object Lessons, p.

eng:
5. 	Harden Not Your Heart 	Thu, Jul 16
a. 	What is the danger in ignoring conviction or delaying to respond? 2 Corinthians 6:2; Hebrews 3:7, 8; Luke 12:20, 21.
“Many are quieting a troubled conscience with the thought that they can change a course of evil when they choose; that they can trifle with the invitations of mercy, and yet be again and again impressed. They think that after doing despite to the Spirit of grace, after casting their influence on the side of Satan, in a moment of terrible extremity they can change their course. But this is not so easily done. The experience, the education, of a lifetime, has so thoroughly molded the character that few then desire to receive the image of Jesus.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 33, 34.
b. 	What should we do when we realize that our heart and life are not in harmony with God? Psalm 139:23, 24; 51:10.
“Study God’s word prayerfully. That word presents before you, in the law of God and the life of Christ, the great principles of holiness, without which ‘no man shall see the Lord.’ Hebrews 12:14. It convinces of sin; it plainly reveals the way of salvation. Give heed to it as the voice of God speaking to your soul.”—Ibid., p. 35.
“We have been great sinners, but Christ died that we might be forgiven. The merits of His sacrifice are sufficient to present to the Father in our behalf. Those to whom He has forgiven most will love Him most, and will stand nearest to His throne to praise Him for His great love and infinite sacrifice. It is when we most fully comprehend the love of God that we best realize the sinfulness of sin. When we see the length of the chain that was let down for us, when we understand something of the infinite sacrifice that Christ has made in our behalf, the heart is melted with tenderness and contrition.”—Ibid., p. 36.
bem:
5. 	WIKOSHA UMUTIMA                                                                    Cisano, July 16                                    a. 	Busanso nshi bwaba mukusula ukushininwa atemwa mukushinga-shinga kwa kwasuka? 2 Kolinto 6:2; Abahebele 3:7, 8; Luka 12:20, 21.
“Abengi balekwata ukutalalika kampingu uyo uuba uwa kucushiwa ne langulushi ilya kuti kuti bakwanisha ukwalula imibombele ya bubifi elyo batemwa fye abene; Eico tacili icakusakamika nangu bakwata ukucita ama bwite ya luse nga yashaba ya kankala, elyo inshita ne nshita [ libili-libili ]  balakwata uku cetekela ukuti bakakwata ukushininwa inshita imbi. Batontonkanya ukuti panuma ya kubomba nangu fye ni mukupusanako no mupashi wacikuku, panuma na bakwata ukuposa ulwambu lwabo kulubali lwa kwa shetani, elyo nomba munshita iya boni ubwa shika, kuti baisakwata ukukwanisha ukwa kwalula imibombele yaboni no kuba aba kupusushiwa. Lelo ici tacaba icayanguka ukucicita.Ifibelesho, na masambililo, ifya bwikashi buno fyalisa bombesha apakalamba mukwalula umubele kucifiko cakuti banonofye e bakwata ukukabila icipasho cakwa Lesa.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 33, 34.
b. 	Cinshi tulingile ukucita ilyo lintu twaba aba kukutuluka ukuti umutima wesu pamo fye no mweo wesu tafili mu bwampano na Lesa? Amalumbo 139:23, 24; 51:10.
“Soma ishiwi lyakwa Lesa ukupitila mu mapepo. Ili ishiwi ilyakwata ukupelwa kuntanshi yobe, mwifunde lyakwa Lesa pamo fye na mu mweo wakwa Klistu , fyaba fipope ifikalamba ifya mushilo, ifyakuti ngataufikwete tawingakwata ukumona Shikulu.’ Abahebele 12:14. Ishiwi likwata ukushinina ulubembu; mukutambalala likwata ukusokolola inshila yepusukilo. Ba uwa kukwata ukulyumfwikisha nge shiwi ilyakwa Lesa ililekwata ukusosa ku mweo obe.”—Ibid., p. 35.
“Ifwe twaba ababembu abacilamo, lelo Klistu  akwete ukufwa pakuti twingaba abakwelelwa. Ubololoke ubwelambo lyakwe bwalikwata ukuba ubwafikapo kukulangishiwa kuntanshi yakwa wishi mulubali lwesu. Eico kuli abo bonse bantu akwata ukwelela ukucila, bali no kuba aba kumutemwa ukucila kabili bali no kwiminina mupepi-pepi ne cipuna cakwe icabufumu kukukwata ukumulumbanya ena pa mulandu wa citemwiko cakwe icakulisha kabili pamo fye ne lambo lyakwe ilyabula impela. Nilyo linefye lintu twaba abakumfwikisha ukutemwa kwakwa Lesa elyo twingakakwata ukukutuluka ububi bwaba mu lubembu. lintu twakwata ukumona ubutali ubwa munyololo untu wakwete ukutobaulwa pali baifwe pa mofye nelyo tuba abakumfwikisha cimo ica bulilambo ubwabula impela buntu Klistu  akwata ukucita palubali lwesu, umutima ulakwata ukusunguluka no kusakamana pamo fye no kulosha.”—Ibid., p. 36.
