1. 	God’s Mercy 	Sun, Jul 19
a. 	When convicted of sin, what are we to do? Proverbs 28:13; James 5:16.
“The conditions of obtaining mercy of God are simple and just and reasonable. The Lord does not require us to do some grievous thing in order that we may have the forgiveness of sin. We need not make long and wearisome pilgrimages, or perform painful penances, to commend our souls to the God of heaven or to expiate our transgression; but he that confesseth and forsaketh his sin shall have mercy.”—Steps to Christ, p. 37.
b. 	What attitude does this require in us? Proverbs 15:33; 19:23; Psalm 34:18.
“Those who have not humbled their souls before God in acknowledging their guilt, have not yet fulfilled the first condition of acceptance. If we have not experienced that repentance which is not to be repented of, and have not with true humiliation of soul and brokenness of spirit confessed our sins, abhorring our iniquity, we have never truly sought for the forgiveness of sin; and if we have never sought, we have never found the peace of God. The only reason why we do not have remission of sins that are past is that we are not willing to humble our hearts and comply with the conditions of the word of truth. Explicit instruction is given concerning this matter. Confession of sin, whether public or private, should be heartfelt and freely expressed.”—Ibid., pp. 37, 38.
bem:
1. 	ULUSE LWA KWA LESA.	Cimo, Jul 19
a. 	Ilyo twasininwa no lubembe finshi tufwile ukucita? Amapinda28:13; Yakobo 5:16.
“Ifikomo ififwaikwa pa kunonka uluse lwakwa Lesa fyaliba ifyayanguka  kabili ifya lungama kabili ifyalungatana. Shikulu tafwaya ifwe ukucita ifintu fimo ifyakulungulusha pakutila twingakwata ukulekelelwa ulubembu. Tatulekabila ukupanga amalendo ayatali aya bwina Kristu atemwa ukucita ifya kuicululusha, pa kulenga imipashi yesu ibe iyalinga kuli Lesa wa mu mulu nangu pakuti shingakonsolwelwa imembu shesu. Lelo uyo onse uwayebelela ulubembu lwakwe ali no kupokelela uluse.”—Steps to Christ, p. 37.
b. 	Mubele nshi ici cilekabila muli baifwe? Amapinda15:33; 19:23; Amalumbo 34:18.
Abo aba shanaisha imipashi yabo kuntanshi yakwa Lesa mu kusumina ukusekwa kwabo, tabalafikilisha icikomo cakubalilapo ica kupokelelwa.  Nga cakuti tatulakwatapo ukulapila ukwa kukana bwelela kufyo twalapileko, mu kulunguluka pamo kulepula kwa mutima mukuyebelela imembu, kabili no kupata imembu shesu, ninshi tatulasanga ukwelelwa ukwa cishinka, kabili fye ici nga tatwacifwaya, ninshi tatulaba abakusanga umutende na Lesa. Umulandu fye umo ico imembu shesu isha kunuma shi shafumishiwapo wakutila tatwaba abainasha imitima yesu no kunakila ku fikomo ififwaikwa ifye shiwi lya cine. Amakambisho aya yanguka yalipelwa pa cikumine uyu mulandu. Ukuyebelela kwa lubembu, cibe ni palwalala nangula mubumfisolo, kufwile kwafuma panshi ya mutima kabili mukulondololwa ukwabula ukulupita mumbali.”—Ibid., pp. 37, 38.

eng:
2. 	Confessing and Forgiving 	Mon, Jul 20
a. 	When we have offended another, whom have we also offended? Psalm 51:4.
The apostle says, ‘Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that we may be healed.’ James 5:16. Confess your sins to God, who only can forgive them, and your faults to one another. If you have given offense to your friend or neighbor, you are to acknowledge your wrong, and it is his duty freely to forgive you. Then you are to seek the forgiveness of God, because the brother you have wounded is the property of God, and in injuring him you sinned against his Creator and Redeemer.”—Steps to Christ, p. 37.
b. 	Why must we forgive others? Matthew 6:14, 15; Ephesians 4:32.
“He who is unforgiving cuts off the very channel through which alone he can receive mercy from God. We should not think that unless those who have injured us confess the wrong we are justified in withholding from them our forgiveness. It is their part, no doubt, to humble their hearts by repentance and confession; but we are to have a spirit of compassion toward those who have trespassed against us, whether or not they confess their faults. However sorely they may have wounded us, we are not to cherish our grievances and sympathize with ourselves over our injuries; but as we hope to be pardoned for our offenses against God we are to pardon all who have done evil to us.”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, pp. 113, 114.
c. 	What should teach us our duty toward humanity? 1 Peter 4:8; Romans 13:8.
“Let Christ, the divine Life, dwell in you and through you reveal the heaven-born love that will inspire hope in the hopeless and bring heaven’s peace to the sin-stricken heart. As we come to God, this is the condition which meets us at the threshold, that, receiving mercy from Him, we yield ourselves to reveal His grace to others.”—Ibid., pp. 114, 115.
“The inhumanity of man toward man is our greatest sin. Many think that they are representing the justice of God while they wholly fail of representing His tenderness and His great love. Often the ones whom they meet with sternness and severity are under the stress of temptation. Satan is wrestling with these souls, and harsh, unsympathetic words discourage them and cause them to fall a prey to the tempter’s power.”—The Ministry of Healing, p. 163.
bem:
2. 	UKUYEBELELA NO KULEKELELWA                                            Cibili, Jul 20
a. 	Ilyo twacena umunensu, nani na umbi tukwata ukukalifya? Amalumbo 51:4.
“Umutumwa alanda, ‘Yebeleleni ifilubo fyenu kuli umo no munankwe, ukuti muposhiwe. Yakobo 5:16. Yebeleni imembu shenu kuli Lesa, uyo fye eka uwinga shilekelela ne filubo fyenu kuli cila umo no mu nankwe. Nga cakutila waliba ne cilubo ku munobe atemwa umwina mupalamano, ulingile ukusumina icilubo cobe, kabili uli mulimo wakwe nao ukukwelela apabula umutengo. Elyo nomba ulombe ubwelelo kuli Lesa, pantu munonko ucenene cikwatwa cakwa Lesa, elyo na mukumucena walibembuka kuli kalenga kabili  wakwe kapususha.”—Steps to Christ, p. 37.
b. 	Mulandu nshi ifwe tufwile ukulekelela abanensu [bambi]? Mateo 6:14, 15; Ephesians 4:32.
“Uyo uu shibelelo luse alaputula inshila imo fye mpo umo ena engapokelelamo uluse ukufuma kuli Lesa. Tatulingile ukutotonkanya ukuti, Kanofye balya bene ba tucenene ifwe bayebelele ifilubo fyabo ifwe tuli abalungama mukwikalilila mukukana babelela uluse.
Lubali lwabo, takuli na kutwishika, bena ukunasha imitima yabo ukupitila mu kulapila no kuyebelela; lelo tufwile ukukwata umutima wa nkumbu kuli abo abatubifishe ifwe, cibe nabayebelela ifilubo fyabo atemwa iyo. Nangula cakuti na batucena, tatufwile ukusungilila ifya kukalifiwa fyesu atemwa ukuba no bulanda pa kucenwa kwesu; lelo ifyo ifwe tucetekela ukwelelwa kwa milandu yesu kuli Lesa tulingile naifwe ukwelela bonse abo abacitile icibi kuli baifwe..”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, pp. 113, 114.
c. 	Bushe ni cinshi icifwile ukusambilisha umulimo wesu kubantu nse?? 1 Petro 4:8; Roma 13:8.
“Lekeni klistu, umweo wa buLesa, ekale muli imwe kabili ukupitila muli imwe asokolole ukutemwa ukwa  kumulu  uko ukuli no kupela isubilo muli abo abashakwata isubilo elyo no kuleta umutende wa ku mulu ku mutima uyo uwatitikishiwa no lubembu. Ilyo tuleisa kuntanshi yakwa Lesa, ici e cikomo tufwile twakwanisha a kabala ntanshi,, ukuti  ukupokelela uluse lwakwe ukufuma kuli wene, tulekabilwa fwebene ukulangisha ukusokolola icikuku cakwe kuli bambi..”—Ibid., pp. 114, 115.
“Ubunkalwe bwa muntu ku muntu munankwe e lubembu lwesu ulwakulisha. Abengi batontonkanya ukuti baleimininako umulinganya wakwa Lesa ilyo bena munshila imbi   na bafilwa umupwilapo ukwimininako inkumbu shakwe elyo no kutemwa kwakwe ukukalamba. Ilingi line abo bakumanya mu bukalushi  no kushupa [mubuluku] balaba  abatitikishiwa pesamba lya matunko. Satana alaba uwakulwa neyi imipashi, na mubuluku, mu mashiwi ya bunkalwe alakwata ukubanasha no kubalenga ukuwila mu  maka yakwa katunka.”—The Ministry of Healing, p. 163

eng:
3. 	Specific and Sincere 	Tue, Jul 21
b. 	What sins must be confessed publicly while others are confessed to God alone? Psalm 32:5; Matthew 5:23, 24.
“True confession is always of a specific character, and acknowledges particular sins. They may be of such a nature as to be brought before God only; they may be wrongs that should be confessed to individuals who have suffered injury through them; or they may be of a public character, and should then be as publicly confessed. But all confession should be definite and to the point, acknowledging the very sins of which you are guilty.”—Steps to Christ, p. 38.
“Sin of a private character is to be confessed to Christ, the only mediator between God and man. . . . Every sin is an offense against God, and is to be confessed to Him through Christ. Every open sin should be as openly confessed.”—Gospel Workers, p. 216.
a. 	What is the purpose of true confession? 1 Samuel 12:19.
“In the days of Samuel the Israelites wandered from God. They were suffering the consequences of sin; for they had lost their faith in God, lost their discernment of His power and wisdom to rule the nation, lost their confidence in His ability to defend and vindicate His cause. They turned from the great Ruler of the universe and desired to be governed as were the nations around them. Before they found peace they made this definite confession: ‘We have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.’ 1 Samuel 12:19. The very sin of which they were convicted had to be confessed.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 38, 39.
b. 	What practical action should follow confession? Isaiah 1:16, 17; Ezekiel 33:15.
“Confession will not be acceptable to God without sincere repentance and reformation. There must be decided changes in the life; everything offensive to God must be put away. This will be the result of genuine sorrow for sin.”—Ibid., p. 39.
“Every converted soul will, like Zacchaeus, signalize the entrance of Christ into his heart by an abandonment of the unrighteous practices that have marked his life. Like the chief publican, he will give proof of his sincerity by making restitution.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 556.
bem:
3. 	UKUKANA PITA MUMBALI KAMBILI MU CISHINKA                                    Citatu, Jul 21
a. 	Bushe ni membu nshi Ishifwile ukuyebelela palwalala ilyo shimbi ishakuyebelela mu bumfisolo kuli Lesa fye eka? Amalumbo 32:5; Mateo 5:23, 24.
“Ukuyebelela kwabafye  lyonse mu musango uwa lungatana, elyo no kusumina imembu isho, kuti shaba mu musango wakuti shilingile ukutwalafye kuli Lesa ekafye; atemwa kuti fyaba filubo ififwile ukwebelelwa ku muntu uyo fya kalifye; nangula shamu musango wa palwalala, ninshi shifwile ukwebelelwa ifyo fine palwalala. Lelo ukuyebelela konse kufwile kwaba mukushininwa kabili ukulanda mu fikomo, ukusumina imembu isho shine ishiletushinina..”—Steps to Christ, p. 38.
“Ulubembu lwa mubumfisolo lufwile ukwebelelwa kuli Klistu, ndubulwila fye umo pakati ka kwa Lesa elyo no muntu. . . . Ulubembu lonse lwaliba mulandu kuli Lesa, kabili lufwile ukwebelelwa kuli wene ukupitila muli Klistu. Ululumbu lwa palwalala lufwile ukwebelelwa ifyo fine palwalala.”—Gospel Workers, p. 216.
b. 	Bushe bukankala nshi ubwa kuyebelela ukwacishinka? 1 Samuel 12:19.
“Mu nshiku sha kwa Samwele abena Israeli balubantile ukufuma kuli Lesa. Balekwata ukucula ne fyalefuma mulubembu; pa mulandu wakuti balilufishe icitetekele muli Lesa, balufishe no ukwiluka kwa maka yakwe pamo na mano ya kutungulula inko, balufishe no kupama mu maka yakwe mu kwimininako elyo no kusumbula umulimo wakwe. Bakene ukukonka intungulushi ikalamba iya mulu ne calo elyo no kufwaya ukulatungululwa nge nko shimbi isho ishabashingulwike. Ilyo tabalasanga umutende bacitile ukuyebelela mukushininwa: na tulundapo pa membu shesu shonse no bubi bwa kuilombela imfumu.’ 1 Samwele 12:19. Ulubembu lulya lwine luntu bashininweko lwali eku yebelela.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 38, 39.
c. 	Bushe cicitwa nshi icifwile ukukonka pa kuyebelela? Esaya1:16, 17; Ezekele 33:15.
“ukuyebelela takuli nakupokelelwa kuli Lesa ukwabula ukulapila ukwa cishinkapamo no kufukulula. Kufwile kwaba ubusalo bwa kwalula [ukwaluka] mu mweo; ifilubo fyonse fifwile ukubikwa pa mbali. Ici ecili no kufuma mukuba no bulanda pa lubembe.”—Ibid., p. 39.
“Umupashi onse uwapilibuka uli no kuba nga Sakeyo, ukulangisha ukwingila kwakwa Klistu mukati ka mutima ukupitila mukuposa ificitwa ifi shalumgama ifyo ifya ikatilile umweo wakwe. Nga kasonkesha mukalamba, ali no kupela icishininkishisho ca bucishinka bwakwe ukupitila mu kubwesha ico afinshishe  .”—The Desire of Ages, p. 556.

eng:
4. 	Danger of Self-Justification 	Wed, Jul 22
a. 	When the Lord asked Adam and Eve about their sin, how did they imply that it was not really their fault? Genesis 3:12, 13.
“Adam could neither deny nor excuse his sin; but instead of manifesting penitence, he endeavored to cast the blame upon his wife, and thus upon God Himself: ‘The woman whom Thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.’ ”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 57. [Author’s italics.]
“After Adam and Eve had eaten of the forbidden fruit, they were filled with a sense of shame and terror. At first their only thought was how to excuse their sin and escape the dreaded sentence of death. When the Lord inquired concerning their sin Adam replied, laying the guilt partly upon God and partly upon his companion. ‘The woman whom Thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.’ The woman put the blame upon the serpent, saying, ‘The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.’ Genesis 3:12, 13. Why did You make the serpent? Why did You suffer him to come into Eden? These were the questions implied in her excuse for her sin, thus charging God with the responsibility of their fall.”—Steps to Christ, p. 40.
b. 	Why does self-justification make confession ineffectual? Job 9:20; Luke 16:15.
“The spirit of self-justification originated in the father of lies and has been exhibited by all the sons and daughters of Adam. Confessions of this order are not inspired by the divine Spirit and will not be acceptable to God. True repentance will lead a man to bear his guilt himself and acknowledge it without deception or hypocrisy.”—Ibid., p. 40.
“We should not try to lessen our guilt by excusing sin. We must accept God’s estimate of sin, and that is heavy indeed. Calvary alone can reveal the terrible enormity of sin. If we had to bear our own guilt, it would crush us. But the sinless One has taken our place; though undeserving, He has borne our iniquity. ‘If we confess our sins,’ God ‘is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.’ 1 John 1:9. Glorious truth!—just to His own law, and yet the Justifier of all that believe in Jesus. ‘Who is a God like unto Thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of His heritage? He retaineth not His anger forever, because He delighteth in mercy.’ Micah 7:18.”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, p. 116.
bem:
4. 	UBUSANSO UBWABA MU KUILUNGAMIKA PALWESU  	Cine, Jul 22
a. 	Ilyo Shikulu aipwishe Adam na Eva pa cikumine ulubembu lwabo, ni munshila nshi ba cibikilemo ukuti tacali mu cituntulu cilubo cabo? Genesis 3:12, 13.
“Adam tekuti akane atemwe kuleuka ulubembu lwakwe; nomba mucifulo cakulangisha ukulapila, ene alaesha ukubika icilubo pa mukashi wakwe, e mukuti na pali Lesa wine: ‘mwanakashi untu mwampele ukuba nankwe, nampela icisabo ca ku muti, naine nindya.’ ”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 57. [Author’s italics.]

eng:
5. 	Open Confession 	Thu, Jul 23
a. 	How did Paul humbly and specifically acknowledge his sin? Acts 26:10, 11.
“The examples in God’s word of genuine repentance and humiliation reveal a spirit of confession in which there is no excuse for sin or attempt at self-justification. Paul did not seek to shield himself; he paints his sin in its darkest hue, not attempting to lessen his guilt. [Acts 26:10, 11 quoted].”—Steps to Christ, p. 41.
b. 	What did Paul declare in his first epistle to Timothy? 1 Timothy 1:15.
“In ourselves we can see nothing but weakness, nothing to recommend us to God, and Satan tells us that it is of no use; we cannot remedy our defects of character. When we try to come to God, the enemy will whisper, It is of no use for you to pray; did not you do that evil thing? Have you not sinned against God and violated your own conscience? But we may tell the enemy that ‘the blood of Jesus Christ His Son cleanseth us from all sin.’ 1 John 1:7. When we feel that we have sinned and cannot pray, it is then the time to pray. Ashamed we may be and deeply humbled, but we must pray and believe. [1 Timothy 1:15 quoted]. Forgiveness . . . is a gift unto us, having in the spotless righteousness of Christ its foundation for bestowal.”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, pp. 115, 116.
c. 	If we confess our sins, what has God promised? 1 John 1:9.
“The humble and broken heart, subdued by genuine repentance, will appreciate something of the love of God and the cost of Calvary; and as a son confesses to a loving father, so will the truly penitent bring all his sins before God. And it is written, [1 John 1:9, quoted].”—Steps to Christ, p. 41.
bem:
“Panuma Adam alya ku cisabo icabindwa, baisushiwemo na mano ya nsoni elyo no mwenso. Pa kabala ntanshi batontonkenye fye ifyo balaleuka ulubembu lwabo no kufulumuka ubupingushi bwa mfwa. Ilyo shikulu aipwishe pa cikumine ulubembu lwabo Adamu ayasike, mukubika ukusekwa lubali pali Lesa kabili lubali pa mutemwikwa wakwe. ‘umwanakashi untu mwampele ukuba na ine, eumpele ica kumuti naine nalya, ‘umwanakashi nao abika icilubo pa nsoka, atila, ‘ni nsoka imbeleleke naine na cilya.’ Ukutendeka 3:12,13. Mulandu nshi wapangile insoka? Mulandu nshi wailengele ukwisa mu Edeni? Aya eyali amepusho ya kuleseshamo pa lubembu lwakwe, mukupela Lesa imilandu no kushingamwa kwa kuwa kwabo.”—Steps to Christ, p. 40.
b. 	Mulandu nshi ukuilungamika kulengela ukuyebelela ukukana ba na maka? Job 9:20; Luka 16:15.
“Umupashi wa kuilungamika wafumine kuli wishi wa bufi kabili ne ci calilangishiwa mu bana bakwe bonse abume na banakashi abakwa Adamu. Ukuyebelele kwa uyu musango takusekelelwa no mupashi wa buLesa elyo takuli na kupokelelwa kuli Lesa. Ukulapila ukwa cishinka kuli no kutungulwila umuntu ukusenda ukusekwa kwakwe umwine pamo no kusumina ukwabula ukufutika [uukubepa] atemwa muli bumumbi-munda..”—Ibid., p. 40.
“Tatufwile ukwesha ukucefyako ulubembu lwesu ukupitila mu kakuleshamo ulubembu. Tufwile ukusumina ifyo Lesa apenda ulubembu, no kutila lwalibipa mu cituntulu fye. Kaufali eka uwingallanga ukubipa no kukalipa kwa lubembu. Nga cakuti twingaisendela ukusekwa kwa lubembu lwesu, kuti lwatushonaula ifwe. Lelo uyo ushaba na lubembu alisenda ulubali lwesu: nangu tushaba abashalinga, alisenda amampulu yesu. Nga twayebelela imembu shesu, ‘Wene wacishinka kabili mulungami ku kulekelela imembu shesu, no kutusamba kukowela konse. 1 Yohane 1:9. Ululumbi Ululumbi lwa cine!--- umulungami kwi funde lyakwe, lelo nomba kalungamika wa abo bonse abasumina muli Yesu. Ni uyani umulungu uwaba nga Lesa uulekelela amampulu uulabako kuli bumpula mafunde bwa bashalako abacikwatwa cakwe? Tasamika umutima wakwe mukutwalilila ukukalipa pantu ena abekelwa mu luse.’ Micah 7:18.”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, p. 116
5. 	UKUYEBELELA PALWALALA	Chisano, Jul 23
a. 	Bushe ni munshila nshi Paulo mu kuicefya asumininemo mu cishinka ulubembu lwakwe? Acts 26:10, 11.
“Ifya kumwenako mwi shiwi lyakwa Lesa ifya kulapila ukwa cishinka pamo no kuicululusha fisokolola umupashi wa kuyebelela umo umushaba icakuleseshamo pa lubembu atemwa ukwesha mu bulungami bwa kuikwatila. Paulo tafwaile ukuicingilisha umwine; alangishe ulubembu lwakwe mukubipisha kwa luko. Taeseshe ukucefyako [ukwangusha] ukusekwa kwakwe. [Acts 26:10, 11 nga mashiwi yapelwe].”—Steps to Christ, p. 41.
Bushe finshi Paulo alandile muli kalata wakwe uwa ntanshi kuli Timote? 1 Timothy 1:15.
“Muli baifwe tatwingamonwamo nangu cimo lelo ubunake fye.Tapali nangu cimo icingatulenga ukwishibikwa kuli Lesa, kabili Satana atweba ukuti tacikwete ne incito iwe ukulapepa. Tekuti tundape utulema twesu utwa mibele. ilyo twaesha ukwisa kuli Lesa, umulwani ali no kutepelesha [ukutotosha] ati: tacikwete incito iwe ukupepa; bushe te iwe wacicita na cilya icintu icabipa? Bushe taubembukile Lesa no konaula kampingu obe? Lelo kuti twayeba umulwani ukuti ‘ umulopa wakwa Yesu Klistu umwana Wakwe uutusamba ukutufumya ku membu shonse.  1 Yohane 1:7. Ilyo twayumfwa ukuti natubembuka kabili tekuti tupepe, iyo ine e nshita tufwile ukupepa. Nangu twinba uu kusekwa kwa musango shani tufwile fye ukupepa no kutetekela. [1 Timothy 1:15: nga mashiwi yapelwe].  Ukulekelelwa …… cabupe kuli baifwe, ico tukwata mu bulungami bwabula akalema ubwa kwa klistu umufula wa kupela kwa ciko.”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, pp. 115, 116.
Nga cakuti twayebelela imembu shesu ni finshi Lesa alaya? 1 Yohane 1:9.
“Abaicefya kabili abalepula umutima, abainasha mukulapila ukwa cishinka, bali no kutasha ifintu fimo ifya kutemwa ukwa kwa Lesa elyo no mutengo wa Kaufali [calvary] kabili ngefyo umwana ayebelela kuli wishi uwa mutemwa, efyo no ulapila mucishinka atumbula imembu shakwe shonse kuntanshi yakwa Lesa. Kabili calilembwa,  [1 Yohane 1:9].”—Steps to Christ, p. 41.
AMEPUSHO YA KUPITULUKAMO CILA UMO 	Mutanda, Jul 24
1. 	Ilyo twayebelela imembu shesu kuli Lesa mucishinka, bushe tupendwa shani kuntanshi yakwa Lesa?
2. 	Ni mu fintu fyamusango nshi fimo umo ukuyebele kumo kufwile ukucitwa ku bantu bambi, kabili mulandu nshi?
3. 	Mulandu nshi cabela icikankala ukuyebelela mu fikomo [mukulungatana no mulandu]?
4. 	Londolola ubusanso ubwaba mu kuilugamikila?
5. 	Bushe finshi ififumamo mu kuyebelela ukwa kuinasha?
Ubupe bwe Sabata Lya Ntanshi
Akasaka Ntobo 1, 2026
Iciputulwa ca Masambililo ica Cisaka Cikalamba
“Kanshisha umwaice umo afwile ukubela: pantu ilyo akakula ta kafumemo” (Mapinda 22:6).
Twikele mu nshiku ishayafya. Mukati ka mekashi ya bantu abo abaisulamo icalo, umo ukushingamwa kwa kusambilisha abana besu pamo na bapungwe mukatina ka kuli Yehoba kule kabilwa mu ka mpampa ukucila ifyo cali kale. Pamo nga bafyashi, nga ba kasambilisha, kabili nge filundwa fya mubili wakwa Kristu, na tu kwata umulimo uwa shishiwa uwa kupeteyanya inkulo iyo ili no kucingilila icitetekelo mu kukosa, mukuicefya, kabili mu kushininkisha. Ukwiluka kwa masambililo ya cishinka e cine, ico cifwile cabikwa pa mupashi ico icishinga lufyanishiwa ukupitila mufilubo ifyo fyaba fye konse konse.”—Testimonies for the Church, vol. 6, p. 131.
Ukupitila muli ili ilangulushi, iciputulwa ca masambililo ica cisaka cikalamba calikwata ukubombesha pa maka mu kukosha no kufungulula ama sukulu ya minshoni yesu ukushinguluka icalo. Umwingi fye mu ncende shesu mwaliba ukubulisha ifikulwa, imisambilishishe ipya iya muntantiko ya masambililo, kabili ne fya kubomfya ifya lingilwa kuli bu mupashi bwa basambi besu. Mukucishapo, ifyalo ifingi fyalikwata ukulomba ukufiswilako incende ishipya isha masambilo isho ishi shikwata fye ukutungilila fye amasambililo umwaba fye ukwilukafye kwa mufitabo lelo na umo umuli ifipope fya mbila nsuma ya muyaya. E mulandu wine ici icabupe icaibela cili no kutungilila inshi ncende shitatu ishikankala isha masambililo:
1. Ukupanga cipya cipya ama sukulu ayabapo aya minshoni.
2. ukwimika ama sukulu ayapya mu ncende umuli ubukabilo ku masambililo ayaba SDARM.
3. Mukufungulula ukwilula no kuleta umulimo wa kupanga ififwaikwa mu masambililo ifyo fya pangwa ne bumba lyesu ilya balolesha pa masambililo mu kwafwa amasambilo yak u calo pamo pene fye na mu masukulu ya minshoni mu fitundu ifyalekanalekana  na mumisango ya mitundu.
“Amasambilio ya cishinka cipilibula  ukukashiwa kwa bu minshoni. Onse fye umwana umwaume pamo fye no mwanakashi alikwata ukwitwa mukuba minshoni; twaitilwa ku mulimo wakwa Lesa no wa ku bantu banensu; na pa kutulengwa ukuba abalinga kuli uyu umulimo icifwile caba e butukilo lyesu ilya masambililo yesu. The Ministry of Healing, p. 395.
Eico, tulemupapata, mwe ndume ne nkashi, ukupela ica bupe bwenu mukupelesha mukuba ne cimonwa ca bu minshoni. Ukukwata icibikile ca kuntanshi mu masambililo ya bana na bapungwe caliba cibikilo ca kuntanshi ica cilonganino, mu kusabankanya kwa mbila nsuma, na ku busomboshi bwa kulekelesha.
Shikulu e nga kwata ukufusha icamusangulo wenu kabili no kukosha ubu ubutumikishi ubukankala—kabili na ma sukulu yesu lekeni yabe malubuto aya cishinka ayaleyaka mu mfimfi, mu kupekanya inkulo iya cishinka  ku kwisa ukulelolelwa ukwa kwa kapususha wesu.
— Iciputulwa ca masambililo ica Cisaka Cikalamba

eng:
1. 	The Warfare Against Self 	Sun, Jul 26
a. 	How did Paul describe Christian warfare and the equipment needed for it? Ephesians 6:12–18.
“Satan assailed Christ with his fiercest and most subtle temptations, but he was repulsed in every conflict. Those battles were fought in our behalf; those victories make it possible for us to conquer. Christ will give strength to all who seek it. No man without his own consent can be overcome by Satan. The tempter has no power to control the will or to force the soul to sin. He may distress, but he cannot contaminate. He can cause agony, but not defilement. The fact that Christ has conquered should inspire His followers with courage to fight manfully the battle against sin and Satan.”—The Great Controversy, p. 510.
b. 	Where is Satan trying to obtain complete dominion? Proverbs 4:23.
“As man ‘thinketh in his heart, so is he.’ Proverbs 23:7. The heart must be renewed by divine grace, or it will be in vain to seek for purity of life. He who attempts to build up a noble, virtuous character independent of the grace of Christ is building his house upon the shifting sand. In the fierce storms of temptation it will surely be overthrown.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 460.
bem:
UBULWI MUKULWISHA  BUINE  	cimo, Jul 26
a. 	Ni munshila nshi Paulo alolondolwela ubulwi bwa mwina Klistu elyo ne fyanso fya bulwi ifilekabilwa? Ephesians 6:12–18.
“Satana abikile pali Klistu amatunko ayabipisha kabili aya yafya sana ukwiluka, lelo alifililwe muli cila bulwi. Ayo ama bulwi yalwililwe palubali lwesu; uko ukucimfya kwalengele cibe icayanguka kuli ifwe ukucimfya. Klistu ali no kupela amaka kuli abo aba yafwaya. Takuli umuntu nangu umo uwingacimfiwa kuli shetani ukwabula umwine ukusuminishako. Katunka takwata amaka yakutungulula ubufwayo atemwa ukupatikisha umupashi ukulola ku lubembu. Kuti anaasha, lelo tekuti akoweshe, kuti alenga ukulungulusha, lelo teti akoweshe. Icishinka ici icakuti Klistu alicimfya cifwile cakoselesha bakakonka bakwe no bukose mukulwisha mukukosa ubulwi bwakucimfya lubembu pamo na satana.”—The Great Controversy, p. 510.
b. 	Ni kwisa uko satana ale-esha mukufwaya ukukwata ukuteka mu mupwilapo? Amapinda 4:23.
Ifyo umuntu atontonkanya mu mutima wakwe, ifyo fine efyo aaba. Amapinda 23:7. Umutima ufwile ukubumbululwa ukupitila mu cikuku ca BuLesa., nga teifyo cili no kuba icafye ukufwaya ukusanguluka kwa mweo [mutima]. Uyo uwesha ukukuula “umubelo uwa mano, bumpomfu, palwakwe ukwabula icikuku cakwa Klistu alekuula ing’anda yakwe pa muchanga uu salangana. Mu mabimbi ya matunko ayabipisha mu cituntulu uli fye [umubelo] no kucimfiwa.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 460.

eng:
2. 	The Divine Invitation 	Mon, Jul 27
a. 	What must be given up in order to be a disciple of Christ? Luke 14:33; Matthew 6:24.
“In giving ourselves to God, we must necessarily give up all that would separate us from Him. Hence the Saviour says, [Luke 14:33 quoted]. Whatever shall draw away the heart from God must be given up. Mammon is the idol of many. The love of money, the desire for wealth, is the golden chain that binds them to Satan. Reputation and worldly honor are worshiped by another class. The life of selfish ease and freedom from responsibility is the idol of others. But these slavish bands must be broken. We cannot be half the Lord’s and half the world’s. We are not God’s children unless we are such entirely.”—Steps to Christ, p. 44.
b. 	What divine invitation does the Lord extend to all who desire a renewal of heart and life? Isaiah 1:18; Jeremiah 29:13; James 4:7–10.
“The government of God is not, as Satan would make it appear, founded upon a blind submission, an unreasoning control. It appeals to the intellect and the conscience. . . . God does not force the will of His creatures. He cannot accept an homage that is not willingly and intelligently given. A mere forced submission would prevent all real development of mind or character; it would make man a mere automaton. Such is not the purpose of the Creator. He desires that man, the crowning work of His creative power, shall reach the highest possible development. He sets before us the height of blessing to which He desires to bring us through His grace. He invites us to give ourselves to Him, that He may work His will in us. It remains for us to choose whether we will be set free from the bondage of sin, to share the glorious liberty of the sons of God.”—Ibid., pp. 43, 44.
“Christ was manifested as the Saviour of men. The people were not to trust in their own works, in their own righteousness, or in themselves in any way, but in the Lamb of God which taketh away the sins of the world. In Him the Advocate with the Father was revealed. Through Him the invitation was given, ‘Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.’ This invitation comes sounding down along the lines to us today. Let not pride, or self-esteem, or self-righteousness keep anyone from confessing his sins, that he may claim the promise.”—Fundamentals of Christian Education, p. 239.
bem:
2. 	UBWITE BWA BU LESA 	Cibili, Jul 27
a. 	Bushe ni cinshi cifwile ukulekelwako pakuti ube umusambi wakwa Klistu?? Luka 14:33; Mateo 6:24.
“Mu kuipela kwesu kuli Lesa, tufwile nge fyo cifwile fye ukuba ukuposa fyonse ifyo ifinga tupatula ifwe ukufuma kuli Wene. Efyo kapususha asosa, [Luka 14:33]. Ico conse icingatalusha umutima ukufuma kuli Lesa cifwile ukuposwa [ukulekwa]. Mamone kalubi ka bantu abengi, ukutemwa kwa ndalama, ukufwaya ukunonka ifyuma, munyololo uwakosa uyo uu bakakilila kulubali lwa kwa Satana. Ishina elyo no bucindami bwa mu calo e fipepwa kwi bumba limbi. Umweo wa bukatemwe, ukuilekelesha, elyo no buntungwa bwa kukana sakamana bambi kalubi ka bantu bambi. Lelo amabumba ya bucaibela yafwile ukutobeka. Tekuti tube citika aba kwa shikulu kabili citika aba ku calo. Tatuli bana bakwa Lesa kanofye twaipela fye umupwilapo.  Steps to Christ, p. 44.
b. 	Bushe bwite nshi ubwa buLesa ubo Lesa atambike kuli bonse abo abalekabila ukubumbululwa kwa mutima pamopene no mupashi? Esaya1:18; Yeremia 29:13; Yakobo 4:7–10.
“Ubuteko bwakwa Lesa tabwaba, ngefyo satana engabupanga ukumoneka “ukulimbwa pa mufula wa kulanakila fye kwa mubupofu, ukutungululwa ukwabula ukutontonkanya. Ubu ubuteko] Bupapata ku matontonkanyo elyo  na kuli kampingu. . . . Lesa tapatikisha ubufwayo bwa fibumbwa fyakwe. Teti apokelele ukupepwa uko ukushili kwa kuitemenwa kabili ukushipelwa mukubikako amaano. Ukunakila ukwa kupatikishiwa kuli no kucingilisha ukukula kwa matontonkanyo atemwa umubelo; kuti calenga umuntu ukuba nge cintu icitungululwafye. Ico icishaba ubufwayo bwakwa kabumba. Afwaya ukuti umuntu, uyo uwapa mulu mu mulimo wakwe uwa maka ya bubumbo bwakwe, akafike mukulunduluka ukwa sumbukisha ukulingana napo engapela. Alabika kuntanshi yesu umushinku uwepalo apo wene afwaya ukutufisha ukupitila mu cikuku cakwe. Alatwita ifwe ukuipela fwebene kuli wene, ukuti engabomba ubufwayo bwakwe muli ifwe. Cashalila kuli baifwe ukusala nga cakuti tuli no kukakulwa ku busha bwa lubembu, ku kukumako ku buntungwa bwa bukata bwa bana bakwa Lesa.”—Ibid., pp. 43, 44.
“Klistu alangishiwe nga kapususha wa bantu. Abantu tabaalingile ukucetekela mu milimo yabo, mu bulungami bwabo, atemwa mu nshilafye ili yonse, nomba mu mwana wa mpanga uwa kwa Lesa uyo uulesenda imembu shaba pano isonde. Muli wene ndubulwila  kuli Tata alilangishiwe. Ukupitila muli wene ubwite bwalipelwe, ‘iseni nomba tukalulushanye, efyasosa Shikulu: nangu imembu shenu shakashika ce, shikabe ishabuuta nge mfula yabuuta; nangu shakashikakisha nge nsalu ya citatilo, shikabe shabuuta nga masako ya mpanga.’ Ubu ubwite buleumfwika ukwisa kuli baifwe ilelo. Mwileka icilumba, atemwa ukuininika, atemwa ubulungami bwakuikwatila fikatilile umo ukukana yebelela imembu shakwe, pakutila enga lomba ubu ubulayo.”—Fundamentals of Christian Education, p. 239.

eng:
3. 	Christ Gave All 	Tue, Jul 28
a. 	What has given Christ the right to take His children to heaven? Colossians 1:14; Hebrews 7:25.
“Amid the awful darkness, apparently forsaken of God, Christ had drained the last dregs in the cup of human woe. In those dreadful hours He had relied upon the evidence of His Father’s acceptance heretofore given Him. He was acquainted with the character of His Father; He understood His justice, His mercy, and His great love. By faith He rested in Him whom it had ever been His joy to obey. And as in submission He committed Himself to God, the sense of the loss of His Father’s favor was withdrawn. By faith, Christ was victor.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 756.
“In the gift of Jesus, God gave all heaven. From a human point of view, such a sacrifice was a wanton waste. To human reasoning the whole plan of salvation is a waste of mercies and resources. Self-denial and wholehearted sacrifice meet us everywhere. Well may the heavenly host look with amazement upon the human family who refuse to be uplifted and enriched with the boundless love expressed in Christ. Well may they exclaim, Why this great waste?
“But the atonement for a lost world was to be full, abundant, and complete. Christ’s offering was exceedingly abundant to reach every soul that God had created. It could not be restricted so as not to exceed the number who would accept the great Gift. All men are not saved; yet the plan of redemption is not a waste because it does not accomplish all that its liberality has provided for. There must be enough and to spare.”—Ibid., pp. 565,566.
b. 	What does Jesus require of all who desire to be His children and want to be able to receive His Spirit? Proverbs 23:26.
“[Jesus] is waiting with pitying tenderness to hear the confessions of the wayward, and to accept their penitence. He watches for some return of gratitude from them, as the mother watches for the smile of recognition from her beloved babe. The great God teaches us to call Him Father. He would have us understand how earnestly and tenderly His heart yearns over us in all our trials and temptations.”—Gospel Workers, p. 210.
“What do we give up, when we give all? A sin-polluted heart, for Jesus to purify, to cleanse by His own blood, and to save by His matchless love. And yet men think it hard to give up all! I am ashamed to hear it spoken of, ashamed to write it.”—Steps to Christ, p. 46.
bem:
3. 	KLISTU APEELE FYONSE                                                      Citatu, Jul 28
a. 	Bushe cinshi capela Klistu insambu shakusenda abana bakwe ukubatwala ku mulu? Kolose 1:14; Abahebere 7:25.
“Pakati ka mfifi iyakutinya, mukumoneka kwa kuba ngo wa kulekeleshiwa na Lesa, Klistu anwene ifiko ifyakulekelesha muli kapu wa kulungulusha kwa bantunse. Muli isho inshita shamfwa ashintililefye pa cishininkishisho ica kupokelelwa na wishi icapelwe kuli wene ku nshita ya kunuma. Ali uwaishiba bwino umubele wakwa Wishi. Alyumfwikishe umulinganya wakwe, uluse lwakwe, no kutemwa kwakwe ukwakulisha. Ukupitila mu citetetekelo atushishe muli wene kuli uyo alekwatila lyonse nsansa sha ku mumfwila [ukummunakila]. Elyo mukunakila aipele umwine kuli Lesa, amano yakumfwa ukulufya ububile kuli wishi yalifuminemo. Ukupitila mu citetekelo klistu aishileba kacimfya.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 756.
“Mu cabupe ica kwa Yesu, Lesa apele umulu onse, ukupitila mukumona ukwa buntunse, ilambo lya musango uyu lyali bonaushi. Mu kutontonkanya kwa muntu nse ubwanshiko bonse ubwe pusukilo konaula inkumbu pamo ne fikwatwa. Ukuikanya pamo nelambo lyakuipela no mutima onse filatukumanya ifwe muncende fye shonse. Cisuma limbi umulalo onse uwa ku mulu ukulolesha mu kupapuka pa lupwa lwa bantuse abo abalekana ukuba abasumbulwa pamo no kwikushiwa no kutemwa ukushakwata impela uko ukwalangishiwa muli Klistu. Bushe kuti caba Cisuma, kuli bene limbi ukupunda ukuti, ni pa mulandu nshi ubu ubonaushi ubukalamba bwacitilwe?
“Nomba icikonsolwelo ica kukonsolwelako icalo ico icalubile cali nokuba ica mwisulo ose, icafulisha pamo no kufikapo. Ilambo lyakwa Klistu lyali ilya kulisha apakalamba kabili ilyafikapo mu kukuma cila mupashi untu Lesa alengele. Tecakwata fye mpendwa iya kumanina iya abo abali no kupokelela ici icabupe icikalamba. Abantu bonse tabapusuka; nomba umutande we pusukilo tawaposwa apafye pa mulandu wakuti tawapwisha ukubomba mu buntungwa fyonse ifyo wapangilwe. Kulingile kwaba ifyalinga pamo ne fya kushalako.”—Ibid., pp. 565,566.
b. 	Bushe finshi Yesu afwaya kuli abo bonse abakabila ukuba abaana bakwe no kufwaya ukuba abalinga ukupokelela umupashi wakwe? Amapinda 23:26.
“[Yesu] alelolela munkumbu shingi ukumfwa ku kuyebelela kwa bantu abalufye nshila, no kupokelela ukulapila kwabo. Alelolesha kuli bamo ukubwela kwa kupela ukutasha, ngefyo nyina amona ukuseka kwa kumwishiba ukufuma kanya kakwe. Lesa mukulu atufunda ifwe ukumwita ena Tata. Akabila ifwe ukwishiba ifyo umutima wakwe mucishinka kabili munkumbu ufwaisha ifwe ilyo tuli mu mesho na mu matunko.”—Gospel Workers, p. 210.
“Finshi ifwe tuposa, ilyo twapela fyonse? Umutima uwakantanishiwa ku lubembu, pakuti Yesu ausangulule, ukuusamfya mu mulopa wakwe, kabili uku upususha ukupitila mu kutemwa kwakwe ukushinga pashanishiwa. Nomba abantu batontonkanya ukuti cintu cakosa ukulekelako fyonse! Ndaba uwansoni ukumfwa ico cilesoswa, kabili uwansoni no kucilemba.”—Steps to Christ, p. 46.

eng:
4. 	A Complete Surrender 	Wed, Jul 29
a. 	What was the earnest desire of Paul for the believers? Romans 12:1; 1 Thessalonians 5:23.
“Though addressed to ancient Israel, these words contain a lesson for the people of God today. When the apostle appeals to his brethren to present their bodies ‘a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God,’ he sets forth the principles of true sanctification. It is not merely a theory, an emotion, or a form of words, but a living, active principle, entering into the everyday life. It requires that our habits of eating, drinking, and dressing be such as to secure the preservation of physical, mental, and moral health, that we may present to the Lord our bodies, not an offering corrupted by wrong habits, but ‘a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God.’ ”—The Sanctified Life, pp. 27, 28.
“We are to give ourselves to the service of God, and we should seek to make the offering as nearly perfect as possible. God will not be pleased with anything less than the best we can offer. Those who love Him with all the heart, will desire to give Him the best service of the life, and they will be constantly seeking to bring every power of their being into harmony with the laws that will promote their ability to do His will.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, pp. 352, 353.
b. 	When the multitude heard the discourse of Peter on the day of Pentecost, what was the burden on their hearts? Acts 2:37, 38.
“[The multitude] heard the disciples declaring that it was the Son of God who had been crucified. Priests and rulers trembled. Conviction and anguish seized the people. ‘They were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?’ Among those who listened to the disciples were devout Jews, who were sincere in their belief. The power that accompanied the words of the speaker convinced them that Jesus was indeed the Messiah. . . .
“Peter urged home upon the convicted people the fact that they had rejected Christ because they had been deceived by priests and rulers; and that if they continued to look to these men for counsel, and waited for them to acknowledge Christ before they dared to do so, they would never accept Him. These powerful men, though making a profession of godliness, were ambitious for earthly riches and glory. They were not willing to come to Christ to receive light.”—The Acts of the Apostles, pp. 43, 44.
bem:
4. UKUIPELA BUONSE [UMUPWILAPO] 		Cine, Jul 29
a. 	Bushe kufwaya nshi ukwacishinka ukwa kwa Paulo ku basumina? Roma 12:1; 1 Thessalonians 5:23.
“Nangula yalandilwe kuli israeli wa kale, aya amashiwi nayakwata isambililo ku bantu bakwa Lesa ilelo. Ilyo umutumwa apapatile ku ba bwananyina banankwe ukutula imibili yabo ‘bulilambo bwa mweo, ubwa mushilo ubwa suminishiwa kuli Lesa, apampamike icipope ca kushishiwa ukwa cishinka. Tacabafye nge langulushi, nge mimfwile ya mubili, atemwa umusango wa mashiwi, lelo ica mweo, icipope ca muficitwa, icisangwa mu mweo wa cilabushiku. Cikabila ukuti imibele yesu iya milille, ukunwa, pamo ne mifwalile ibe mu nshila iya kusungilila imibili yesu, amatontonkanyo, elyo ne mibele yesu iyabumi, pakuti twingatula kuli shikulu wesu imibili yesu. Te lambo lya kantanishiwa ne mibele iibi, lelo ilambo ilya mweo, ilya mushilo kabili ilyapokelelwa kuli Lesa.’ ”—The Sanctified Life, pp. 27, 28.
Tufwile ukuipela fwebene ku mulimo wakwa Lesa, kabili tufwile ukufwaya ukupanga ilambo ilyafikapo nga cingacitwa. Lesa tali na kusekeshiwa ne cintu icili conse ico icishifikilepo mu busuma bwa co ifwe twingapela kuli wene. Abo abamutemwa ne mitima yabo yonse, bali no kufwaya ukumupela umulimo uwafikapo uwa mu mweo. Kabili bali no kutwalilila ukulafwaya ukuleta amaka yonse aya myeo yabo mu bwampano pamo na mafunde pakuti be ngalundulula amaka yabo ku kucita ubufwayo bwakwe.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, pp. 352, 353.
b. 	Ilyo aba cinabwingi baumfwile ukulanda kwakwa Petelo pa bushiku bwa pa Pentecost , cisendo nshi icaishile mu mitima yabo? Acts 2:37, 38.
“[Aba cinabwingi] baumfwile abasambi balesosa ukuti, ali mwana wakwa Lesa uwatanikwe. Bashimapepo ne ntungulushi balitutwime. Ukushininwa pamo no kulunguluka fyaikete abantu. Ba cenenwe mu mitima yabo, no kulanda kuli Petelo pamofye na batumwa bonse, mwe bamunyinefwe, twalacita shani? Pali abo abaumfwile ku basambi pali aba Yuda abacishinka, abo abali abacishinka munkusumina kwabo. Amaka ayali mu mashiwi yakwa kalanda ya libashinine ukuti Yesu mucishinka ali ni Mesaya…….
Petelo aibukisheko abo bantu abashininwe icishinka icakutila balikene Klistu pa mulandu balibepelwe ukupitila muli bashimapepo ne ntungulushi; no kutila nga cakuti bakonkanyapo ukulafwaya bumpanda maano ukufuma kuli aba baantu no kulalolela ukuti bena babalilepo ukusumina Klistu ilyo bena tabalaesha ukucita ico, ninshi tabakatale abamusumina. “Aba baantu ababulamba, nangu baitungile ukuba aba  bu Lesa, bali abatinamina ifyuma no Lulumbi lwa pa calo. Tabaali abakukabila ukwisa kuli Klistu ku kupokelela ulubuto..”—The Acts of the Apostles, pp. 43, 44.

eng:
5. 	Maintaining Surrender 	Thu, Jul 30
a. 	What brings the conviction that we may be fully consecrated to the Lord and able to bear the image of Christ? Philippians 2:12, 13.
“God does not bid you fear that He will fail to fulfill His promises, that His patience will weary, or His compassion be found wanting. Fear lest your will shall not be held in subjection to Christ’s will, lest your hereditary and cultivated traits of character shall control your life. ‘It is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of His good pleasure.’ Fear lest self shall interpose between your soul and the great Master Worker. Fear lest self-will shall mar the high purpose that through you God desires to accomplish. Fear to trust to your own strength, fear to withdraw your hand from the hand of Christ and attempt to walk life’s pathway without His abiding presence.”—Christ’s Object Lessons, p. 161.
b. 	How can steadfastness of faith and complete surrender to right principles be maintained? Galatians 2:20; Matthew 16:24, 25.
“Those who would gain the blessing of sanctification must first learn the meaning of self-sacrifice. The cross of Christ is the central pillar on which hangs the ‘far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory.’ ”—The Acts of the Apostles, p. 560.
“You cannot change your heart, you cannot of yourself give to God its affections; but you can choose to serve Him. You can give Him your will; He will then work in you to will and to do according to His good pleasure. . . .
“Through the right exercise of the will, an entire change may be made in your life. By yielding up your will to Christ, you ally yourself with the power that is above all principalities and powers. You will have strength from above to hold you steadfast, and thus through constant surrender to God you will be enabled to live the new life, even the life of faith.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 47, 48.[Authors italics.]
bem:
5. 	UKUTWALILILA UKUIPELA [UKUCIMBA] 	Cisano, Jul 30
a. 	Bushe cinshi cileta ukushininwa pakuti twingaba abashishiwa kuli shikulu no kuba
abalinga ukusenda icpasho cakwa Klistu? Philippians 2:12, 13.
“Lesa teeba  iwe ukuba no mwenso ukuti  ali nokufilwa ukufikilisha amalayo yakwe, ukuti ukutekanya kwakwa kuli no kufilwa, atemwa inkumbu shakwe shili nokupwa. Tina epali ubufwayo bobe tabuletelwe pesamba lya kunakila ku bufwayo bwakwa Klistu, epali utumibele utwa cifyalilwa utwa mu mubelo obe twatungulula umweo obe. Ni Lesa uu bombela muli iwe kuli kampingu [mubufwayo] pamo penefye no kucita muli iwe ifisuma ifimusekesha.’ Tina epali buine bwacilinganya ubwampano bobe pakati ka mweo obe na Kabomba mukalamba. Tina epali ubufwayo bwa buine bwaonaula ibutukilo lyobe ilya pamulu ilyo Lesa alekabila ukufikilisha ukupitila muli iwe. Tina ukucetekela mu maka yobe we mwine, tina ukufumya ukuboko kobe ukufuma kuli Klistu elyo nokwesha ukwenda munshila ya mweo ukwabula ukubapo kwakwe.”—Christ’s Object Lessons, p. 161.
b. 	Bushe ni munshila nshi ukwikatisha ku citetekele elyo no kuipela umupwilapo ku fipope ifyalungama kwingabelwa ukwasungililwa?  Galatia 2:20; Mateo 16:24, 25.
“Abo abali nokunonka ipaalo lya kushishiwa bafwile mukubalilapo basambilila ubupilibulo bwakuipela bulilambo. Ulupanda lwakwa Klistu e luceshi lwa pakati apo apashintilila ubukulu bonse elyo no bufino bonse ubwa lulumbi lwa muyayaya.’ ”—The Acts of the Apostles, p. 560.
“Tekuti ucinje umutima obe, tekuti palobe wemwine upele kuli Lesa ifyo umutima ufwaya; lelo kuti wasala ukumubombela. Kuti wamupela ubufwayo bobe; elyo ena engabomba muli iwe ku bufwayo no kucita ukulingana na ku busuma bwakwe ubumusekesha.. . . .
“Ukupitila mukubomfya kwa bufwayo munshila ilyalungama, ukwalula muli fyonse kuti kwacitwa mu mweo. Ukupitila mukupela ubufwayo bobe kuli Klistu, uli no kuyampanya pamo na maka ayo aya cila pali bashamfumu na bamaka. Uli no kukwata amaka ukufuma ku mulu mu kukwikatilila mu kukosa, eco ukupitila mukuipela kuli Lesa mukutwalilila uli no kulengwa ukwikala umweo uupya pamo fye no mweo wa citetekelo.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 47, 48.

eng:
Personal Review Questions 	Fri, Jul 31
1. 	What is necessary for success in the battle against the enemy of our souls?
2. 	What is the real battle in order to have victory over an already-defeated foe?
3. 	What can we learn from Christ’s gift for our salvation?
4. 	What is the purpose of God for the believers, both physically and spiritually?
5. 	If our will is in accordance with the will of God, what will be experienced daily?
bem:
AMEPUSHO YA KUYASUKILA CILA UMO                                          Mutanda, Jul 31
1. 	Bushe finshi ifyafwaikwa pakuti tucimfye mu bulwi no mulwani wesu uwa mipashi?
2. 	Bushe bulwi nshi ubwacishinka pakutila twingakwata ukucimfya umulwani wesu uyo uwacimfiwa kale?
3. 	Bushe ni finshi twi ngasambilila ku cabupe cakwa Klistu pe pusukilo lyesu?
4. 	Bushe bufwayo nshi ubwa kwa Lesa pa basumini ubwa ku mubili pamo pene na ku mupashi?
5. 	Nga cakuti ubufwayo bwesu buli mu bwampano no bufwayo bwakwa Lesa, finshi tuli no kulapitamo muli cila bushiku no bushiku?

eng:
1. 	Forgiveness and Peace 	Sun, Aug 2
a. 	What is God’s wonderful promise of forgiveness and peace? 1 John 1:9.
“You see that your life has been filled with selfishness and sin. You long to be forgiven, to be cleansed, to be set free. Harmony with God, likeness to Him—what can you do to obtain it?
“It is peace that you need—Heaven’s forgiveness and peace and love in the soul. Money cannot buy it, intellect cannot procure it, wisdom cannot attain to it; you can never hope, by your own efforts, to secure it, But God offers it to you as a gift, ‘without money and without price.’ Isaiah 55:1. It is yours if you will but reach out your hand and grasp it.”—Steps to Christ, p. 49.
b. 	What is another important promise that will transform the entire being into a new man in harmony with God? Ezekiel 36:26.
“You have confessed your sins, and in heart put them away. You have resolved to give yourself to God. Now go to Him, and ask that He will wash away your sins and give you a new heart. Then believe that He does this because He has promised. This is the lesson which Jesus taught while He was on earth, that the gift which God promises us, we must believe we do receive, and it is ours.”—Ibid., pp. 49, 50. [Author’s italics.]
bem:
1. 	UKULEKELELA ELYO NO MUTENDE  	Cimo, Aug 2
a. 	Bushe bulayo nshi ubwa kwa Lesa ubwakulisha ubwa kwelela elyo no mutende? 1 Yohane 1:9.
“Ulamona ukuti umweo obe waisulamo na bukaitemwe pamo no lubembu. Ulafwaisha ukuti wingalekelelwa, ukusambwa, no kukakulwa, no kuba no bwampano na Lesa, ukupalana nankwe..—finshi wingacita pakuti wingakwata ukunonka ici? —
Mutende iwe untu ulekabila“—ukulekelelwa kwa mulu no mutende pamo no kutemwa mu mupashi. Indalama tekuti shishite ici, amano tekuti yashite ici, amano tekuti yacinonke; ta wingaba ausubila, ukupitila mu maka yobe ukunonka ici, lelo Lesa apela ici kuli iwe nge cabupe fye, ‘ukwabula indalama kabili apabula umutengo.  Esaya55:1. Cobe nga wacifwaya, lelo fungulula aukuboko kobe no kucibuula.”—Steps to Christ, p. 49.
b. Bulayo nshi na bumbi ubukankala ubuli no kwalula umweo onse mukuba mu buntu bupya mubwampano pamo na Lesa? Ezekele 36:26.
“Na uyebelela imembu shobe, kabili na mutima naushifumyamo. Na usala ukuipela kuli Lesa. Nomba kabiye kuli wene, no ku mwipusha ukuti asambe imembu shobe no ku kupela umutima uupya. Kabili cetekela ukuti nacita ici pa mulandu wakuti alilaile.. ici e cisambililo ico Yesu afundile ilyo ali pa calo, ukutila icabupe ico Lesa atulaya, tufwile twacetekela ukuti natupokelela, elyo caliba cesu.”—Ibid., pp. 49, 50

eng:
2. 	Life Through Christ 	Mon, Aug 3
a. 	What did Jesus tell the paralytic at Bethesda to do, and what can we learn from this experience? John 5:1–9.
“Let us turn to the story of the paralytic at Bethesda. The poor sufferer was helpless; he had not used his limbs for thirty-eight years. Yet Jesus bade him, ‘Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.’ The sick man might have said, ‘Lord if Thou wilt make me whole, I will obey Thy word.’ But, no, he believed Christ’s word, believed that he was made whole, and he made the effort at once; he willed to walk, and he did walk. He acted on the word of Christ, and God gave the power. He was made whole.”—Steps to Christ, p. 50.
“Jesus had given him no assurance of divine help. The man might have stopped to doubt, and lost his one chance of healing. But he believed Christ’s word, and in acting upon it he received strength.
“Through the same faith we may receive spiritual healing. By sin we have been severed from the life of God. Our souls are palsied. Of ourselves we are no more capable of living a holy life than was the impotent man capable of walking. There are many who realize their helplessness, and who long for that spiritual life which will bring them into harmony with God; they are vainly striving to obtain it. In despair they cry, ‘O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from this body of death?’ Romans 7:24, margin. Let these desponding, struggling ones look up. The Saviour is bending over the purchase of His blood, saying with inexpressible tenderness and pity, ‘Wilt thou be made whole?’ He bids you arise in health and peace.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 203.
b. 	What is promised to the sinner through Christ? 2 Chronicles 7:14; Hosea 14:4.
“You cannot atone for your past sins; you cannot change your heart and make yourself holy. But God promises to do all this for you through Christ. You believe that promise. You confess your sins and give yourself to God. You will to serve Him. Just as surely as you do this, God will fulfill His word to you. If you believe the promise—believe that you are forgiven and cleansed—God supplies the fact; you are made whole, just as Christ gave the paralytic power to walk when the man believed that he was healed. It is so if you believe it.
“Do not wait to feel that you are made whole, but say, ‘I believe it; it is so, not because I feel it, but because God has promised.’ ”—Steps to Christ, p. 51. [Author’s italics.]
bem:
UMWEO MULI KLISTU 	Cibili, Aug 3
a. 	Bushe finshi Yesu ayebele uwa bulebe ukucita pa Betisaida, elyo finshi winga sambilila ukufuma kuli ici icibelesho?  Yohane 5:1–9.
“Iseni nomba tuloleshe pe lyashi lya wabulebe pa Betisida. “umupina uwaculisha takwete uwakumwafwa; tabomfeshepo amolu yakwe pa myaka amakumi yatatu. Lelo Yesu amwebele, ‘ima, senda umusengele obe, no kwenda.’  umuntu uwalwele nga lilandile, mwe Shikulu nga cakuti mwanenga ukuba umutuntulu nalaumfwa kwi shiwi lyenu. Lelo awe. Acetekele amashiwi yakwa Klistu ukusumina ukuti nalengwa ukuba umutuntulu. Kabili apangile ici icitwa pamuku fye umo. Aimine no kwenda, kabili alyendele. Abombele pa mashiwi yakwa Klistu, na Lesa amupele amaka. Alengelwe ukuba umutuntulu.”—Steps to Christ, p. 50.
“Yesu tamupelepo ubulayo bwa bu Lesa ubwa kumwafwa. Umuntu uyu nga aliminine no kutendeka ukutwishika, no kulufya ishuko fye limo ilya kuposhiwa. Lelo acetekele amashiwi yakwa Klistu, kabili mukubombela pali yalya amashiwi, apokelele amaka.
“Ukupitila mu citetekelo cimo cine kuti twapokelela ubundapishi bwa ku mupashi. Ukupitila mu lubembu twaliba abapatulwa ku mweo wakwa Lesa. Imipashi yesu yalifunshika. Palwesu tatwaba na maka yakwikala umweo uwa mushilo ukucila pali filya fyali umuntu uwanakuka untu ashakwete amaka yakwenda. Kwaliba abantu abengi abakutuluka ubunake bwabo, kabili abalolela ulya umweo uwa bumupashi uyo uuli no kubaleta mu bwampano pamo na Lesa; balelwisha apafye ukuti baunonke. Mu kucululuka balapunda, iye ne muntu wankumbabulili ine, nani akampokolola ku mubili uyu uwamfwa?’ Roma 7:24, lekeni abo ababa abanashiwa, abawishikana benune amenso yabo. Umupusushi acili aleloleshe pa mutengo wa mulopa wakwe, alelanda munkumbu elyo no luse ulushingalondololwa, ‘bushe ulekabila ukuba umutuntulu [ukuposhiwa]?’ alekweba ukwima mu mutende pamo na mubumi.”—The Desire of Ages, p. 203.
b. 	Bushe finshi fyalaiwa ukufuma ukupitila muli Klistu? 2 Imilandu 7:14; Hosea 14:4.
“Tekuti ukonsolole imembu shobe ishakunuma. Tekuti walule umutima obe no kuipanga ukuba uwa mushilo. Lelo Lesa alilaya ukucita ifi fyonse kuli iwe ukupitila muli Klistu. Iwe sumina fye bulya bulayo. Ufwile no kumubombela. Ne lyo line fye wakwata ukucita ci mucishinka, Lesa ali no kufikilisha amashiwi yakwe kuli iwe.. Nga cakuti wacetekela ubu ubulayo —sumina ukuti naulekelelwa kabili na uusambwa—Lesa alafikilisha icishinka; naulengwa cipya cipya, ngafilya fine Klistu apele amaka ya kwenda ku wabulebe ilintu fye asumine ukuti na poshiwa. Efyo cili na kuli iwe nga wacetekela.
“Wilolela ukumfwa ukuti naulengwa ukupola, lelo sosa, ‘nacetekela, efyo cili, te pamulandu wakuti naumfwa atemwa ukumona lelo ni pa mulandu wakuti Lesa alilaya.’ ”—Steps to Christ, p. 51. [Author’s italics.]

eng:
3. 	ACCEPTED IN THE BELOVED 	Tue, Aug 4
a. 	When Jesus is accepted as Saviour, what happens to past sins? Romans 3:24, 25; 5:1, 9, 10.
“ ‘What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them,and ye shall have them.’ Mark 11:24. There is a condition to this promise—that we pray according to the will of God. But it is the will of God to cleanse us from sin, to make us His children, and to enable us to live a holy life. So we may ask for these blessings, and believe that we receive them, and thank God that we have received them. It is our privilege to go to Jesus and be cleansed, and to stand before the law without shame or remorse.”—Steps to Christ, p. 51. [Author’s italics.]
b. 	What standing does the believer have before God? Romans 8:1.
“While the Christian’s life will be characterized by humility, it should not be marked with sadness and self-depreciation. It is the privilege of everyone so to live that God will approve and bless him. It is not the will of our heavenly Father that we should be ever under condemnation and darkness. There is no evidence of true humility in going with the head bowed down and the heart filled with thoughts of self. We may go to Jesus and be cleansed, and stand before the law without shame and remorse.”—The Great Controversy, p. 477.
“When we surrender ourselves wholly to God, and fully believe, the blood of Christ cleanses from all sin. The conscience can be freed from condemnation. Through faith in His blood, all may be made perfect in Christ Jesus. . . . We are not to be anxious about what Christ and God think of us, but about what God thinks of Christ, our Substitute. Ye are accepted in the Beloved.”—Selected Messages, bk. 2, pp. 32, 33.
c. 	What change should be recognized by all who have entered into this covenant relationship with God? 1 Peter 1:18, 19; 1 Corinthians 6:19, 20; Galatians 3:26.
“Henceforth you are not your own; you are bought with a price. [1 Peter 1:18, 19 quoted.] Through this simple act of believing God, the Holy Spirit has begotten a new life in your heart. You are as a child born into the family of God, and He loves you as He loves His Son.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 51, 52.
bem:
3. 	AKUPOKELELWA MU BATEMWIKWA  	Citatu, Aug 4
a. 	Ilyo Yesu apokelelwa ngo mupusushi, finshi ficitika ku membu shakale ? Roma 3:24, 25; 5:1, 9, 10.
“Ifyo fyonse ifyo mukabila, ilyo mwapepa, cetekele ukuti namupokelela, kabili muli no kupokela. Mark 11:24. Kwaliba icikomo cimo icfwaikwa kuli ubu bulayo—ukuti tupepe ukulingana no bufwayo bwa kwa Lesa. Nomba bufwayo bwakwa Lesa ukutusangulula ku lubembu, ukutupanga ifwe ukuba abaana bakwe, no kutulenga ifwe ukwikala umweo uwa mushilo. Eco kuti twalomba aya amapalo, kabili no kucetekela ukuti na tuyapokelelwa, no kutasha Lesa ukuti na tuyapoelela. Lishuko lyesu ukuya kuli Klistu no kuba aba wamishiwa, kabili no kwiminina kuntanshi yefunde ukwabula ukusekwa no kusebana.”—Steps to Christ, p. 51. [Author’s italics.]
b. 	Bushe bwiminino nshi buntu umusumini akwata kuntanshi yakwa Lesa? Roma 8:1.
“Ilyo umweo wa mwina Klistu upangwa mu kuicefya, taufwile kabili walakwata ukulangisha ubulanda pamo no kuisusha. Caliba lishuko lya muntu fye onse ukwikala ukuti Lesa enga mupokelela no kumupala. Tacaba bufwayo bwakwa Shifwe wesu uwa ku mulu ukuti ifwe tubelelefye pe samba lya kusekwa kabili mu mfifi. Tacaba ica kushininkishishako ukuicefya ukwacishinka ukupitila mukuya na twinamika imitwe yesu panshi libe mutima mwiswile amatontonkanyo ya buine. Kuti twaya kuli yesu no kuba aba sangululwa, kabili no kwiminina kuntanshi ye funde ukwabula ukusekwa.”—The Great Controversy, p. 477.
“Ilyo twaipela muli buonse kuli Lesa, kabili twasumina mucishinka, umulopa wakwa Klistu utusangulula ku lubembu lonse. Kampingu kuti aba uwakakulwa ukufuma ku kukowela. Ukupitila mu kucetekela umulopa wakwe, fyonse kuti fyalengwa ukuba ifyafikapo muli Klistu . . . . tatufwile ukuba abasakamikwa pafyo Klistu pamo na Lesa bengatontonkanya pali baifwe, lelo pafyo Lesa atontonkanya pali Klistu, cifuta mulandu wesu. Muli abapokelelwa ukupitila mu watemwikwa.”—Selected Messages, bk. 2, pp. 32, 33.
c. 	Bushe kwalulwa nshi ukufwile kwamoneka kuli bonse abaingila mu bwampano bwa cipangano na Lesa? 1 Petro 1:18, 19; 1Kolinto 6:19, 20; Galatia 3:26.
“Nomba tamuli ba mwebene; mwashitilwe mu mutengo. [1 Petro1: 18,19]  ukupitila muli ici cicitwa icayanguka ica kusumina muli Lesa, umupashi wa mushilo walileta umweo uupya mu mutima. Uli ngo mwana uwafyalwa mu lupwa lwakwa Lesa, kabili alikutemwa ngefyo atemwa umwana wakwe.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 51, 52

eng:
4. 	Walking with Christ 	Wed, Aug 5
a. 	How is the believer expected to conduct himself ? Colossians 2:6.
“Now that you have given yourself to Jesus, do not draw back, do not take yourself away from Him, but day by day say, ‘I am Christ’s; I have given myself to Him;’ and ask Him to give you His Spirit and keep you by His grace. As it is by giving yourself to God, and believing Him, that you become His child, so you are to live in Him. The apostle says, ‘As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in Him.’ Colossians 2:6.
“Some seem to feel that they must be on probation, and must prove to the Lord that they are reformed, before they can claim His blessing. But they may claim the blessing of God even now. They must have His grace, the Spirit of Christ, to help their infirmities, or they cannot resist evil. Jesus loves to have us come to Him just as we are, sinful, helpless, dependent. We may come with all our weakness, our folly, our sinfulness, and fall at His feet in penitence. It is His glory to encircle us in the arms of His love and to bind up our wounds, to cleanse us from all impurity.”—Steps to Christ, p. 52.
b. 	What is the provision for mistakes made in the learning process? 1 John 2:1, 2.
“Put away the suspicion that God’s promises are not meant for you. They are for every repentant transgressor. Strength and grace have been provided through Christ to be brought by ministering angels to every believing soul. None are so sinful that they cannot find strength, purity, and righteousness in Jesus, who died for them. He is waiting to strip them of their garments stained and polluted with sin, and to put upon them the white robes of righteousness; He bids them live and not die.”—Ibid., pp. 52, 53.
c. 	Explain how we are strengthened on this journey. 1 John 1:7; Galatians 5:16, 17, 25.
“Those who walk in wisdom’s ways are, even in tribulation, exceeding joyful; for He whom their soul loveth, walks, invisible, beside them. At each upward step they discern more distinctly the touch of His hand; at every step brighter gleamings of glory from the Unseen fall upon their path; and their songs of praise, reaching ever a higher note, ascend to join the songs of angels before the throne.”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, p. 140.
bem:
4. 	UKWENDA NA KLISTU 	Cine, Aug 5
a. 	Bushe umusumini finshi enekelwa ukucita ? Kolose 2:6.
Nomba apo iwe waipela kuli Yesu, tekwesha ukubwelela inuma, wi-ifumya we mwine ukufuma kuli wene, lelo ubushiku no bushiku ulande ukuti ‘ ine ndi wakwa Klistu. Naliipela kuli wene; kabili umulombe ukukupela umupashi wakwe no kukubakilila ukupitila mu cikuku cakwe. Ngefyo caba mukuipela we mwine kuli Lesa, no kusumina muli wene, ukuti ube umwana wakwe, efyo ulingile no kwikala muli wene.  Umutumwa alanda, ‘ngefyo nomba wapokelela Shikulu Yesu Klistu efyo wenda na muli wene’ Kolose 2:6.
“Cimoneka ukuti bamo bomfwa ukuti balingile ukuba mukweshiwa, kabili ukuti bashininkishiwe na Shikulu ukuti na bacinja [ukulapila], elyo tabalalomba amapalo yakwe. Lelo kuti balomba amapalo yakwa Lesa nangufye ni nomba line [apapene] bafwile ukukwata icikuku cakwe, umupashi wakwa Klistu, uwa kubafwa mukunaka kwabo. Nga teifyo tekuti baicingililwe ku ububi.  Yesu alatemwa ifwe ukwisa kuli wene ifyo fine ifyo tuli, ababembu, ababulesubilo, abalekabila kafwa. Kuti twaisa na mabunake yesu yonse, ubuwele-wele bwesu, ububembu bwesu, no kuwa pankasa shakwe mu mukulapila. Bukata bwakwe ukutukupa [ukutufimba] ifwe mu maboko yakwe aya kutemwa no kutukaka pa filonda fyesu, ukutusangulula ku kukowela konse.”—Steps to Christ, p. 52.
b. 	Bushe cinshi cacitwapo pa mulandu wa filubo twacitile mu nshita sha kusambilila? 1 Yohane 2:1, 2.
“Bika pambali umutunganya onse uwakuti amalayo yakwa Lesa tayabelako iwe. Yabelako mpula mafunde fye onse uwalapila. Amaka ne cikuku fyalipelwa ukupitila muli klistu ukaba ifyakuletwa ukupitila muli bamalaika abatumikila ku mupashi onse uwasumina. Takuli nangu bamo ababa ababembu sana abakuti teti basange ubukose, bumusangwela, pamo no bololoke muli Klistu, uyo uwabafwilile. Alelolela ukubafula imingila yabo iyakantanishiwa kabili iya koweshiwa no lubembu, no kubafwika imingila iya buuta iya bololoke; alebeba ukuba no mweo te kufwa iyo.”—Ibid., pp. 52, 53.
c. 	Londololeni ifyo ifwe tukoshiwa muli ulu lwendo. 1 Yohane 1:7; Galatia 5:16, 17, 25.
“Abo abenda munshila umwaba amano bena, na nshita sha mafya,  balaba  abakukwatisha ubuseko, pa mulandu wakutila uyo untu umupashi wabo wakwata ukutemwisha, alanda, mukukana moneka pa mbali yabo. Palutampulo fye lonse ulwalola ku mulu balakwata ukumwensekesha ukubekata kwakwe ukwa kuboko; elyo na palutampulo fye lonse balamonapo imyengelele iya yakisha iyalulumbi ukufuma uko bashikwata ukumona iyo iiponena patushila twabo; kabili na munyimbo shabo ishakutasha, isho ishaba pe shiwi lya pa mulu, shilakwata ukunina mu kuminkana ne nyimbo sha bangeli kuntanshi ya cipuna cabufumu.”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, p. 140.

eng:
5. 	The Father’s Redeeming Love 	Thu, Aug 6
a. 	What are the conditions for acceptance by God? Isaiah 55:7; 44:22.
“God does not deal with us as finite men deal with one another. His thoughts are thoughts of mercy, love, and tenderest compassion.”—Steps to Christ, p. 53.
“Whoever under the reproof of God will humble the soul with confession and repentance, as did David, may be sure that there is hope for him. Whoever will in faith accept God’s promises, will find pardon. The Lord will never cast away one truly repentant soul.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 726.
b. 	What is our heavenly Father’s true attitude toward all who have gone astray? Ezekiel 18:32; Luke 15:18–20.
“Satan is ready to steal away the blessed assurances of God. He desires to take every glimmer of hope and every ray of light from the soul; but you must not permit him to do this. Do not give ear to the tempter, but say, ‘Jesus has died that I might live. He loves me, and wills not that I should perish. . . .  The parable tells you how the wanderer will be received: [Luke 15:18–20 quoted].
“But even this parable, tender and touching as it is, comes short of expressing the infinite compassion of the heavenly Father. The Lord declares by His prophet, ‘I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with loving-kindness have I drawn thee.’ Jeremiah 31:3. While the sinner is yet far from the Father’s house, wasting his substance in a strange country, the Father’s heart is yearning over him; and every longing awakened in the soul to return to God is but the tender pleading of His Spirit, wooing, entreating, drawing the wanderer to his Father’s heart of love.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 53, 54. [Author’s italics.]
bem:
5. 	UKUTEMWA UKWAKWA LESA SHIFWE UKWA KUPUSUSHA                       Cisano,aug 6
a. 	Bushe finshi fifwaikwa pakuti tupokelelwe kuli Lesa? Esaya  55:7; 44:22.
“Lesa tabomba naifwe ngefyo abantu abashafikapo babomba na umo no munankwe.  Amatontonkanyo yakwe matontonkanyo ya luse, ukutemwa elyo ne nkumbu sha kutusakamana.”—Steps to Christ, p. 53.
“Uyo onse uuli pesamba lya kwebaulwa na Lesa ali no kunasha umupashi mu kuyebelela pamo no kulapila, nge fyacitile Dabidi mu cishinka, kuti akwata isubilo ukuti kuli isubilo kuli wene. Uyo onse uu pokelela amalayo yakwa Lesa ukupitila mu citetekelo ali no kusanga ubwelelo. Shikuli tali nakutamfya uyo umupashi uwalapila mu cishinka.”—Patriarchs and Prophets, p. 726.
b. 	Bushe mubele nshi uwacishinka untu wakwatata shifwe wesu uwa kumulu kuli abo bonse abalufye nshila? Ezekele18:32;  15:18–20.
“Satana ali uwaipekanya ukwiba amabulayo yakwa Lesa ayapalwa. Afwaya ukufumyapo umwengele onse fye uwesubilo no mwengelele wa lubuto fye onse pa mupashi; nomba taufwile uku musuminisha ukuti acite ici. Tekwesha ukupepeka ukutwi kobe kuli katunka, lelo ulande utile, ‘Yesu afwilile ukuti ine imbe no mweo. Alintemwa, kabili tafwaya ukuti ine nkafwe….. Umulumbe ulekweba ifyo uwaluba ali no kupokelelwa.: [Luka 15:18–20 nga mashiwi yapelwe].
Nangula ni uyu wine umulumbe, mu luse kabili mukwikata umutima ngefyo waba, tekuti ulondolole inkumbu ishi shingalondolola ishakwa Shifwe wa kumulu. Shikulu alanda ukupitila muli kasesema wakwe, nalikutemwa iwe no kutemwa ukwa muyayaya: ni pali ici ntwalilila mu luse kuli iwe [Jeremiah 31:3]. Ilyo umubembu aalifye ukutali ukufuma ku ng’anda ya kwa wishi, ukonaula icakaniko cakwe mu calo ica bweni, umutima wakwa wishi wa lemukabilisha [ukumufulukisha] no ukwalamusha kwa mutima ukwa kubwelela kuli Lesa kwaba ni nkumbu sha kupapata ukufuma ku mupashi wakwe,   Lelo ukupapata ukwa luse ukwa mupashi wakwa Lesa, ukusembeleka, ukupapatila, mukutintila uwalubile ku mutima wakutemwa uwakwa Wishi.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 53, 54.
