eng:
1. 	Light Bearers 	Sun, Sep 20
a. 	What responsibility did Jesus say that His disciples have in this world? Matthew 5:13–16.
“Christians are sent as light bearers on the way to heaven. They are to reflect to the world the light shining upon them from Christ. Their life and character should be such that through them others will get a right conception of Christ and of His service.”—Steps to Christ, p. 115.
b. 	What are believers to be to all men? John 17:18, 23; 2 Corinthians 5:20.
“In every one of His children, Jesus sends a letter to the world. If you are Christ’s follower, He sends in you a letter to the family, the village, the street, where you live. Jesus, dwelling in you, desires to speak to the hearts of those who are not acquainted with Him. Perhaps they do not read the Bible, or do not hear the voice that speaks to them in its pages; they do not see the love of God through His works. But if you are a true representative of Jesus, it may be that through you they will be led to understand something of His goodness and be won to love and serve Him.”—Ibid., p. 115.
c. 	How only is it possible to fulfil this mission? 2 Corinthians 3:2–5.
bem:
1. 	BA KASENDA WA LUBUTO                                                                     Cimo, Sep 20
a. 	Ku shingamwa nshi uko kuntu Yesu asosele ukutila abasambi bakwe bafwile ukukwata mu calo? Mateo 5:13–16.
“Abena Kristu balitumwa mukuba nga bakasenda wa lubuto munshila ukulola ku mulu. Bafwile bakwata uku bengeshimya ulubuto ulo lulekwata ukubengeshima pali bena ukufuma kuli Kristu. Umweo no mubelo wabo fifwile fyaba ifya kutila ukupitila muli bena bambi kuti baba aba kukwatilamo ukwishiba bwino Kristu pamo no mulimo wakwe.”—Steps to Christ, p. 115.
b. 	Bushe abasumini bafwile ukuba shani ku bantu bonse? Yohane 17:18, 23; 2 Korinto 5:20.
“Mu mwana fye onse uwa kwa Lesa, Lesa alitumamo inkalata ku calo. Nga uli ka konka wakwa Kristu, ali kutuma ukuba kalata ku lupwa lobe, ku munshi, mu musebo umo wikala. Yesu, uyo uwikala muli iwe, alekabila ukulanda ku mitima ya abo abashakwata uku mwishiba. Limbi kuti tabakwata ukubelenga icipingo, atemwa tabakwata ukumfwa kwi shiwi ilyo lisosa kuli bena ukpitila mu mapepala yaciko; taba kwata uku mona uluse lwakwa Lesa ukupitila mu milimo yakwe. Nomba ngo limwiminishi uwa cishinka uwa kwa Yesu, kuti limbi caba icakutila ukupitila muli iwe kuti bakwata ukutungululwa ku kumfwikisha cimo ici kumine pa busuma bwakwe no kulengwa ukunonkwa ku kumutemwa no ku mutumika.”—Ibid., p. 115.
c. 	Kupitila fye muli cinshi umo uyu mulimo winga kwatila ukufikilishiwa? 2 Korinto 3:2–5.

eng:
2. 	God’s Kindness 	Mon, Sep 21
a. 	What is the highest demonstration God’s of love toward His children? John 3:16; Romans 5:6–10.
“When we seem to doubt God’s love and distrust His promises we dishonor Him and grieve His Holy Spirit. How would a mother feel if her children were constantly complaining of her, just as though she did not mean them well, when her whole life’s effort had been to forward their interests and to give them comfort? Suppose they should doubt her love; it would break her heart. How would any parent feel to be thus treated by his children? And how can our heavenly Father regard us when we distrust His love, which has led Him to give His only-begotten Son that we might have life? The apostle writes, ‘He that spared not His own Son, but delivered Him up for us all, how shall He not with Him also freely give us all things?’ Romans 8:32. And yet how many, by their actions, if not in word, are saying, ‘The Lord does not mean this for me. Perhaps He loves others, but He does not love me.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 118, 119.
b. 	What proves that God wants to give His children all things? Romans 8:32.
“You who feel the most unworthy, fear not to commit your case to God. When He gave Himself in Christ for the sin of the world, He undertook the case of every soul. ‘He that spared not His own Son, but delivered Him up for us all, how shall He not with Him also freely give us all things?’ Romans 8:32. Will He not fulfill the gracious word given for our encouragement and strength?
“Christ desires nothing so much as to redeem His heritage from the dominion of Satan.”—Christ’s Object Lessons, p. 174.
c. 	How may this love be reflected in us? 1 John 4:9–12.
“Christian workers who succeed in their efforts must know Christ; and in order to know Him, they must know His love. In heaven their fitness as workers is measured by their ability to love as Christ loved and to work as He worked.
“ ‘Let us not love in word,’ the apostle writes, ‘but in deed and in truth.’ The completeness of Christian character is attained when the impulse to help and bless others springs constantly from within. It is the atmosphere of this love surrounding the soul of the believer that makes him a savor of life unto life and enables God to bless his work.”—The Acts of the Apostles, p. 551.
bem:
2. 	ULUSE LWAKWA LESA	Cibili, Sep 21
a. 	Bushe kulangisha shani ukwasumbuka ukwa kutemwa kwakwa Lesa pa bana bakwe? Yohane 3:16; Roma 5:6–10
“Ilyo twa moneka aba kutwishika ukutemwa kwakwa Lesa no kukana cetekela amalayo yakwe tula kwata ukumusalula no ku kalifya mupashi wa mushilo. Bushe nyinefwe kuti aumfwa shani nga cakutlia abana bakwe baletwalilila fye ukuilishanya pali wene, kwati nalimo tabasunga bwino, kwati nalimo tabaposako amano, elyo ninshi amaka yakwe yonse aya mweo wakwe yaba mukulwisha ifingabatemuna pamo no kubatalalika? Nga cingasangwa ukutila balekwata ukutwishika ukutemwa kwakwe; kuti ici cakwata ukulepula umutima wakwe. Bushe umufyashi fye onse kuti aumfwa shani ukulingwa ifi ku bana? Kabili shifwe wa mu mulu wena acimona shani pali ifwe ilyo tuba abakubulisha ukucetekela ukutemwa kwakwe, uko kwa mulengeshe ena no kupela umwana wakwe uyo watemwikwa pakutila ifwe tube no mweo? Umutumwa akwata ukulemba ati,’Uyo ushatengele [ushakenye] umwana wakwe, lelo amupele kuli baifwe bonse, bushe engafilwa ukutupela ifintu fyonse’  Roma 8:32. Nomba nangu caba ifi, abengi bacilli balesosa, ukupitila muficitwa, nga te mu mashiwi ukutila, ‘Shikulu kuli ine taba ifyo acitako. Limbi akwata ukutemwako bambi, nomba ine nakalya fye -  tantemwa..”—Steps to Christ, pp. 118, 119.
b. 	Cinshi cikwata ukushininkisha ukutila Lesa alefwaya ukupela abana bakwe ifintu fyonse? Roma 8:32.
“Iwe we uyumfwa ukutila tawaba uwalinga nangula fye nipanono, wiba na mwenso wa kubika umulandu obe ku ntanshi yakwa Lesa. Ilyo aipele umwine muli Klistu palubembu lwa calo ali kwete ukusenda umulandu wa cila mupashi. ’Uyo ushatengele [ushakenye] umwana wakwe, lelo amupele kuli baifwe bonse, bushe engafilwa ukutupela ifintu fyonse?’ Roma 8:32. Bushe teti akwate ukufikilisha icebo ca cikuku ico capelwe kucikoseleshi  na kubukose bwesu?
“Klistu talekabila icintu icili conse  icikalamba ukucila pa kulubula impyani shakwe ukufuma ku ku kutekwa na shetani.”—Christ’s Object Lessons, p. 174.
c. 	Bushe uku kwine ukutemwa kuti kwamoneka shani na muli ifwe? 1 Yohane 4:9–12.
“Ababomfi abena Klistu abo bakwata ukushuka mu maka yabo bafwile ukwishiba Klistu; na pakutila benga mwishiba, bafwile ukwishiba ukutemwa kwakwe. Mu mulu ukulinga kwabo pamo ngaba bomfi kulingilwa ku maka bakwata mukutemwa nga kulya kwine kwa kwete Klistu kabili na mukubomba kulya kwine awete ukubombelamo.
‘Twitemwa fye mu cebo,’’ umutumwa akwete ukulemba, ‘nomba mu ci citwa na mu cine.’ Ukupwililila kwa mubelo wa mwina Klistu ku nonkwa ilyo ukufwaisha kwa kwafwa bambi no kubapala kwa kwata ukwalamushiwa ukulafuma mukati mu kutwalilila. Musango wa uku ukutemwa mukuba uwa kushinguluka umupashi wa musumini e wingamulenga ena ukuba kapususha wa mipashi no kulenga Lesa ukupala umulimo wakwe”—The Acts of the Apostles, p. 551.

eng:
3. 	Christ’s Trials 	Tue, Sep 22
a. 	What characterized the life of Christ in His work for the salvation of men? Isaiah 53:10, 7.
“[Christ’s] life was one of constant self-sacrifice. He had no home in this world, except as the kindness of friends provided for Him as a wayfarer. He came to live in our behalf the life of the poorest, and to walk and work among the needy and the suffering. Unrecognized and unhonored, He walked in and out among the people for whom He had done so much.”—Gospel Workers, pp. 42, 43.
“[The Son of God’s] tears were not for Himself, though He well knew whither His feet were tending. Before Him lay Gethsemane, the scene of His approaching agony. The sheepgate also was in sight, through which for centuries the victims for sacrifice had been led, and which was to open for Him when He should be ‘brought as a lamb to the slaughter.’ Isaiah 53:7. Not far distant was Calvary, the place of crucifixion. Upon the path which Christ was soon to tread must fall the horror of great darkness as He should make His soul an offering for sin. Yet it was not the contemplation of these scenes that cast the shadow upon Him in this hour of gladness. No foreboding of His own superhuman anguish clouded that unselfish spirit. He wept for the doomed thousands of Jerusalem—because of the blindness and impenitence of those whom He came to bless and to save.”—The Great Controversy, p. 18.
b. 	In His suffering and trial, what gave Jesus the courage to complete His work? Isaiah 53:11; Hebrews 12:2.
“The result of the Saviour’s conflict with the powers of darkness is joy to the redeemed, redounding to the glory of God throughout eternity. And such is the value of the soul that the Father is satisfied with the price paid; and Christ Himself, beholding the fruits of His great sacrifice, is satisfied.”—Ibid., p. 652.
“It is often said that Jesus wept, but that He was never known to smile. Our Saviour was indeed a Man of Sorrows, and acquainted with grief, for He opened His heart to all the woes of men. But though His life was self-denying and shadowed with pain and care, His spirit was not crushed. His countenance did not wear an expression of grief and repining, but ever one of peaceful serenity. His heart was a wellspring of life, and wherever He went He carried rest and peace, joy and gladness.”—Steps to Christ, p. 120.
bem:
3. 	AMESHO YAKWA KLISTU	Citatu, Sep 22
a. 	Cinshi cali mu mweo wakwa Klistu mu mulimo wakwe uwa ku pususha abantu? Esaya 53:10, 7.
“Umweo [wakwa Klistu] wali wa mukutwalilila mweo wa bulilambo. Takwete in’ganda muli cino calo, alekwata fye ukumfwilwa uluse ku fibusa ngo mupita nshila. Aishile mu kwikala pa mulandu wesu umweo uwa bucushi, no kwenda no ku bomba pa bantu abakabila na bacushiwa. Mukuba uwabula ukwishibikwa no kucindamikwa, ale endauka mukati ka bantu abo akwete ukucitila ifintu ifingi.”—Gospel Workers, pp. 42, 43.
“[Umwana wakwa Lesa] ifilamba fyakwe te fya kuilila fya pa lwakwe, nangula alishibe uko amakasa yakwe yalelola. Kuntanshi yakwe kwali Getisemani, icakulangisha ukushikitika kwe ukwalepalamina. Ipongolo ya mpamanga nayo yali ku mulola wakwe, apo pankulo fye ishingiifyo fyonse balekwata ukupela ilambo fyalekwata ukupita, iyo yali no kwiswilwa ena ilyo ali no kupelwa ngelwa nga kana kampanga ku kwipaiwa.’ Esaya 53:7. Kabili tapali apatali na pa belele Calvary, incende incende ya kutanikilapo. Pakashila apo Klistu ali fye mupepi no kwendamo pali no kuponena imfimfi iya kutinya ilyo ali no kupela umweo wakwe palubembu. Nomba ili tontonkanyo telya bikile icinshingwa pali wene pali aka akashita ali no kuba  uwa sansamuka. Tamwali fye nangu lilangulushi limo ilya mwenso wa  kulungulushiwa ukwali no kwisaba kwakwe muli uyu umupashi umushali bukaitemwe.  Aloseeshe [alilile] pa bamakana abali no kwisa kwata ukuloba aba mu Yerusalemu—pa mulandu wa bupofu bwabo na bucintomfwa  bwa abo bantu aishile mukupala no kupususha..”—The Great Controversy, p. 18.
b. 	Mukucula kwakwe no kweshiwa, cinshi capele Yesu ukupama kwa kupwisha umulimo wakwe? Esaya 53:11; Abahebere 12:2.
“Icafumine mu bulwi bwakwa kapususha na maka ya mfimfi cali buseko ku balubulwa,  mukulunda ku lulumbi lwakwa Lesa mu muyayaya. Neci e bukankala bwa mupashi ica kutila wishi alikwata ukwikushiwa pa mutengo uwalipilwe; na Kristu umwine, pa ku mona ifisabo fyakwe ifya bulilambo bwawe ubwakulisha, alikwata ukwikushiwa.”—Ibid., p. 652.
“Ilingi cilakwata ukusoswa ukutila Yesu alilile ifilamba, nomba ta cakwata ukwishibikwa ukutila alekwata ukusekelela. Kapususha wesu mucishinka fye ali muntu wa fya Malanda, kabili ali uwaishibana na Malanda, pantu alekwata ukwisula umutima wakwe kufwamalanda ya bantu bonse. Nangula cakutila umweo wakwe wali wa kuikanya kabili ne finshingwa fya ku kalipwa no kusakamana kwa bantu, umupashi ta waleba uwa kutotobela pali ifi. Icinso cakwe ta tacalelangapo icikonko pamo uku sakamikwa, nomba lyonse fye caleba fye ica mutende. Umutima wakwe waleba fye kamfuku mfuku ka mweo, na konse uko aleya alesenda ubutusho pamo no mutende, ubuseko, pamo ne nsansa.”—Steps to Christ, p. 120.

eng:
4. 	Rejoice Amid Trials 	Wed, Sep 23
a. 	When temptation confronts the believer, what is provided so that he may overcome in this spiritual warfare? Ephesians 6:11–18.
“All have trials; griefs hard to bear, temptations hard to resist. Do not tell your troubles to your fellow mortals, but carry everything to God in prayer. Make it a rule never to utter one word of doubt or discouragement. You can do much to brighten the life of others and strengthen their efforts, by words of hope and holy cheer.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 119, 120.
b. 	Why do many hesitate between faith and doubt when tempted and tried? What should they do? Matthew 14:28–31; James 1:2.
“There is many a brave soul sorely pressed by temptation, almost ready to faint in the conflict with self and with the powers of evil. Do not discourage such a one in his hard struggle. Cheer him with brave, hopeful words that shall urge him on his way. Thus the light of Christ may shine from you. ‘None of us liveth to himself.’ Romans 14:7. By our unconscious influence others may be encouraged and strengthened, or they may be discouraged, and repelled from Christ and the truth.
“There are many who have an erroneous idea of the life and character of Christ. They think that He was devoid of warmth and sunniness, that He was stern, severe, and joyless. In many cases the whole religious experience is colored by these gloomy views.”—Ibid., p. 120.
c. 	How is the path of the just bright even in the midst of trial? Proverbs 4:18; Philippians 4:4.
“The road may be rough and the ascent steep; there may be pitfalls upon the right hand and upon the left; we may have to endure toil in our journey; when weary, when longing for rest, we may have to toil on; when faint, we may have to fight; when discouraged, we must still hope; but with Christ as our guide we shall not fail of reaching the desired haven at last. Christ Himself has trodden the rough way before us and has smoothed the path for our feet.
“And all the way up the steep road leading to eternal life are well-springs of joy to refresh the weary.”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, p. 140.
bem:
4. 	UBUSEKO PAKATI KA MESHO	Cine, Sep 23
a. 	Ilyo itunko lya ponene umusumini, cinshi cabikwako pa kutila enga kwata ukucimfya muli ubulwi bwa kuli Bu mupashi? Efeso 6:11–18.
“Bonse balikwata amesho, amalanda aya ya fya ukushipikishako. Mwila eba aya Malanda ku bantu banenu, nomba sendeni fyonse kuli Lesa mwipepo. Cipangeni fye ngefunde ukukana sosapo ishiwi lya kutwishika atemwa ilya kufupula. Kuti wacita ifingi ifinga kulenga umweo obe ukuletela bambi icimwemwe no kukoselesha amaka yabo, ukupitila mu ma shiwi aya bamo isubilo pamo ne cimwemwe ca bumushilo.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 119, 120.
b. 	Cinshi abengi bakwatila ukushinga shinga pakati ka citetekelo pamo no kutwishika ilyo bakwata ukutunkwa pamo no kweshiwa? Finshi bafwile ukucita? Mateo 14:28–31; Yakobo 1:2.
“Kwalibako umupashi uwaba uwashipa uwa titikishiwa ne tunko, uwa bafye pa nembenembe ya kucmfimfiwa mu bulwi bwa kulwikana na bubuine pamo na maka ya bubifi. Mwinasha uyu umupashi muli ubu ubulwi ubwakosa. Mukoselesheni uwaba ifi na mashiwi yesubilo ayo ayali no kukoselesha munshila yakwe. Ukupitila muli ici ulubuto lwakwa Klistu kuti limbi lwakwata ukubalikila pali wene ukufuma kuli iwe. Takwaba fye nelyo fye umo pali ifwe uwaba fye uwaikalila palwakwe umwine.’ Roma 14:7. Ukupitila mulwambu lwesu  ulo tatwingakawata no ku kutuluka bambi kuti bakwata ukukoseleshiwako pamo no kuseleshiwako, atemwa ukunashiwako, no kutalushishiwako kuli Klistu pamo na ku cine.
“Kwaliba abengi abakwata ilangulushi ilyalubana pa cikumine umweo pamo no mubelo wakwa kristu. Batontonkanya ukutila wena ali uwa bundumana kabili takwete ne sansa, uwashupa, umuluku umushabamo no buseko muli wene. Mu fintu fye ifingi umweo wakwe uwa bukapepa bwakwe wakwata ukushingulwa naya amalangulushi aya kuba uwa kuifinya.”—Ibid., p. 120.
c. 	Bushe aakashila k aka mulungami kaba shani akabutushiwa na mukati fye ka mesho Mapinda 4:18; Filipi 4:4.
“Inshila kuti yaba iya filindi kabili iya yafya; kuti kwaba amasanso kumbali fye shonse; tufwile fye ukushipikisha ku kucululuka ukwaba mu bulendo; ilyo kwaba ukunashiwa, ilyo kuli ukufwaisha ubutusho, tufwile twa twalilila fye ukucucutika; ilyo twanakuka, tufwile fye ukutwalila ukulwa; ilyo twakwata ukunashiwa, tufwile nalyo line twatwalilila ne subilo; nomba pa kuba na Klistu nge ntungulushi yesu ta twakafilwe ukufika ku ncende iyo yaba ubukabilo bwesu pa kulekelesha. Klistu alikwata ukwenda munshila iyo yaba iya mikonko mu kututangilila kabili alikwata ukuwamisha amakasa yesu iyi nshila.
“Kabili mu nshila yonse iyo iya yafya iyalola ku mweo wa muyayaya mwaba ifishima fya nsansa ifya kupuputula abanakuka.”—Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, p. 140.

eng:
5. 	Our Reward and Joy 	Thu, Sep 24
a. 	What promise of Jesus should give us reason for joy and for praise to our heavenly Father? Isaiah 41:10; Luke 12:32; I Peter 4:13.
“It is not the will of God that His people should be weighed down with care. But our Lord does not deceive us. He does not say to us, ‘Do not fear; there are no dangers in your path.’ He knows there are trials and dangers, and He deals with us plainly. He does not propose to take His people out of a world of sin and evil, but He points them to a never-failing refuge.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 122, 123.
b. 	Name some other wonderful promises of peace and joy that Jesus has given. John 14:1-3, 27; 15:11; 16:20.
“We cannot but look forward to new perplexities in the coming conflict, but we may look on what is past as well as on what is to come, and say, ‘Hitherto hath the Lord helped us.’ ‘As thy days, so shall thy strength be.’ Deuteronomy 33:25. The trial will not exceed the strength that shall be given us to bear it. Then let us take up our work just where we find it, believing that whatever may come, strength proportionate to the trial will be given.
“And by and by the gates of heaven will be thrown open to admit God’s children, and from the lips of the King of glory the benediction will fall on their ears like richest music, ‘Come, ye blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.’ Matthew 25:34. . . .
“In view of the glorious inheritance that may be his, ‘what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?’ Matthew 16:26. . . . The soul redeemed and cleansed from sin, with all its noble powers dedicated to the service of God, is of surpassing worth; and there is joy in heaven in the presence of God and the holy angels over one soul redeemed, a joy that is expressed in songs of holy triumph.”—Ibid., pp. 125, 126.
bem:
5. 	ICILAMBU NO BUSEKO BWESU                                                      Cisano, Sep 24
a. 	Bulayo nshi ubwa kwa Yesu ubuli no kutupela ifwe ubuseko kabili ne ca kutashishapo kuli shifwe uwaba mu mulu? Esaya 41:10; Luka 12:32; I Petro 4:13.
“Tacaba bufwayo bwakwa Lesa ico icakutila abantu bakwe bafwile ukutitikishiwa na masakamike. Nomba shikulu wesu takwata ukutufutika. Ta sosa kuli ifwe, ‘Mwitina, takuli amasanso mu tushila twenu. Alishiba ukutila mwaliba amesho na masanso, kabili abomba naifwe mukutambala. Taletapo ilangulushi lya kufunyamo abantu bakwe mu calo ca lubembu no bubifi, lelo abasontelela kuli uyo uwaba cubo icishifilwa.”—Steps to Christ, pp. 122, 123.
b. 	Lumbula amalayo yambi aya kupapusha aya mutende no buseko ayo Yesu apela. Yohane 14:1-3, 27; 15:11; 16:20.
“Teti tukwate fye ukulolekesha pa mafya ya kuntanshi ayaleisa, nomba tufwile no kulolekesha na ku fyapita na kufileisa,  no kutila, ‘ Ukufika na pali nomba  shikulu alikwata ukutwafwa.’ Nge fyaba inshiku shobe, e fikaba no bukose bobe.’ Amalango 33:25. Ubwasho tabwakacile pa maka ayo yali no kupelwa mu kubukumanya. Kanshi lekeni tukwate ukusenda umulimo wesu apo pantu twa kwata ukuusangila, mukusumina ukutila conse icikesa, amaka ukulingana no bwesho yakapelwa.
“Kabili pano panono impongolo sha mu mulu shili no kwisulwa mu kwingisha abana bakwa Lesa, elyo kabili ukufuma ku milomo ya mfumu ya lulumnbi ipalo lili no kuponena pa matwi yabo ngo lwimbo lwa ciunda icisuma,‘Iseni mwe basalwa bakwa tata, pyaneni ubufumu ubwateyanushiwa imwe ukutula pa bu bumo bwa calo.’’ Mateo 25:34. . . .
“Pa kumona ubupyani ubwalulumbi ubwali no kuba bwakwe, ‘Nicinshi umuntu ali no kupela mu kukabushanya no mweo wakwe?’ Mateo 16:26. . . . Umweo uyo uwalubulwa no kusambwa ukufuma ku lubembu, uwaba na maka aya bucindami ubwaipelesha ku mulimo wakwa Lesa, waliba uwacilishapo ubukankala, kabili na mu mulu mulaba ubuseko ku ntanshi yakwa Lesa pamo na bangeli bakwe pa mupashi umo uwa kwata ukulubulwa, ubuseko ubo ubukwata ukulangishiwa mu nyimbo sha bukacimfya bwa mushilo.”—Ibid., pp. 125, 126
